chapters.title: Chapter 5160: Golden Wrath! III
paragraphs: Noah knew the smarter and more logical thing to do was to simply bend his head down and not say or do a single thing.

THE Creature had already set everything up with a fabricated history, had carved an entire alternative sequence of events into the readable weavings of what had occurred, had positioned Noah and Emotive and Anaximander as incidental survivors who had only escaped THE Relictus’s assault because the greater targets had consumed THE Relictus’s attention.

If any being watching from outside had been privy to Noah’s internal debate at this moment, they might have scratched their heads and wondered why he was making such an illogical choice when the alibi was already in place and the only required action was silent compliance. Bow the head. Let the Sororis Prima proceed. Accept whatever adjustments she intended to make to the broader Observable Existence and address the consequences later, once her attention had moved elsewhere and his power had grown significantly could address those consequences properly.
It was the correct play. It was the move any outside observer with a functioning grasp of logic would have recommended!
But truly, the moment he bowed his head would feel like a moment where fractures bloomed in his Civilization.

He knew the shape of those fractures because he had carried similar fractures in him across other moments of his existence when circumstances had demanded a capitulation his core had refused to offer.

It was like mundane normal humans crossing paths with other humans who happened to be richer or who held positions of power, and choosing not to meet their eyes or speak up, choosing to shrink slightly so that the passage through the encounter would produce the least friction possible.

The choice got them in less trouble in the moment. The encounter passed and the day continued. But they would remember that shrinking afterward, would carry the memory of having abandoned their posture for the sake of convenience, and across the years the accumulation of such small capitulations produced beings who could no longer recognize the versions of themselves that had existed before the capitulations had begun.
The fractures compounded quietly. The original shape of the person eroded along the seams of every small unspoken yielding.
So yes. It was not the most logical thing to do. But he still dared to look at a Gilded One, at a Sororis Prima, and say no!
Thinking of all this reminded him of a particularly unpleasant memory of a man he had hated with every bone in his body across the full span of his earliest years of existence.
Thinking of all this reminded him of the only man he had ever bent his head down to, because truly, he had feared him.

Not respected, not honored, not admired, but feared in the specific way of a child facing a being whose capacity to hurt him exceeded any capacity he possessed to defend himself. It reminded him...of his father.

The memory flashed in his mind like something he could not suppress, and in the stretched instant of his Hadean Mind pulling this moment into extended perception, the memory unfurled with the crisp brutal clarity of a small human scene he had been carrying across more years than he cared to count.
He was twelve years old at the time, in that broken-down home in the living room with the stained carpet and the curtains that never properly closed.

His father had stood up from the couch where he had been lying most of the afternoon, his stained robe hanging open and his beer belly sticking out in a pale round hemisphere above the waistband of sweatpants that had not been washed in longer than the boy had been alive, holding a leather belt in one thick hand and a half-empty bottle of beer in the other.
The television behind him was playing something loud that nobody was watching. The light in the room was yellow and dim because one of the bulbs in the overhead fixture had been burned out.
His father had asked him coldly.
"I sat and watched you little shit the whole day while your mother worked, and when I bring a woman friend over, you tell your mom about it? Didn’t I tell you to keep your mouth shut?"

The twelve-year-old version of Noah had looked at his father with teary eyes that he had been trying very hard to keep from spilling over, because spilling over would have invited a different and worse kind of response from the man who had just stood up, and he had been defiant.

He had not wanted to see what his father had been doing with the woman friend who kept coming over when his mother went to work. He had not wanted to be told to stay quiet about it. He had not wanted to carry secrets that did not belong to him but that he was being forced to hold for the comfort of an adult who had never shown him a single moment of genuine comfort in return.
So when he had looked up at his father with that small defiant gaze.
The twelve-year-old version had met the eyes of the man who had fathered him, and those eyes had held nothing. Not anger or rage exactly.
Simply the flat contempt of a being who considered the small creature before him an inconvenience that needed to be addressed so that the afternoon could continue undisturbed.
His father had beaten him with that belt again and again.

The first strike had landed across his shoulder and sent him stumbling sideways into the coffee table. The second strike had caught him across the back of his legs as he tried to steady himself. The third strike had knocked him to the carpet entirely, and the subsequent strikes had landed while he was down, the leather biting into his back and his arms and the parts of his body he tried to curl into a protective ball around his chest.
His father had not shouted during the beating. His father had spoken steadily, the way a man speaks when he is delivering a lecture that he believes to be instructive rather than cruel.

"When I talk to you, you look down and listen. You do not look at me like that. You do not look at me with that fucking face of yours like you think you have something to say about anything. I gave you your life. I can take it away. Do you understand? Do you fucking understand?"
The twelve-year-old him had understood.
He had kept his head down after that,crying. The leather belt still landing across his back in measured intervals that had begun to space themselves out as his father’s arm grew tired.

He had not raised his head to meet his father’s gaze for the remainder of that afternoon, and he had not raised it for many afternoons that followed, because the pain of the beatings was real and the fear of the pain was realer still, and he had been twelve years old and his father had been a grown man twice his size and three times his weight, and there had been no framework available to the twelve-year-old in which raising his head would have produced any outcome other than more belt strikes landing across a body that was already bruised in patterns that would take weeks to fade.
He had feared what that useless man, that much bigger than him, could do to him.
He had hated that memory so, so much.

He hated the fact that it lived inside him at all. He hated that no amount of climbing across the years since had permitted him to fully evict the memory from the deeper rooms of his existence where memories of that kind took up permanent residence.

He hated that some part of him, some small twelve-year-old part, still carried the shape of having bowed his head, still remembered the exact texture of the carpet against his cheek, still remembered the way his own tears had tasted when they had pooled against his lips because he could not wipe them away without the wiping being seen as another form of defiance that would have earned additional strikes.
He hated that part of him.

And he had spent every year of his subsequent existence, both the years before Ruination and the unfathomable years since, building himself into a being whose shape could not be returned to that bowed posture by any external force regardless of how grand the external force became.
He was not going to bow his head now.

Not to his dead father. Not to Sororis Prima Elzyana. Not to any Gilded One or Superbius Sisterhood or Paleozoic classification that wanted him to look down. Whatever came as the consequence of refusing to bow, he would pay in whatever currencies existence demanded, or his own currencies!

Because the alternative was to become the twelve-year-old on the carpet again, and that twelve-year-old had already paid his portion of the yielding long ago, and no further portion was available from the being Noah had become in the years since.
He shook his head slightly as if to physically erase the memory, and the stretched instant his Hadean Mind had pulled the reflection into collapsed back into the ordinary flow of time.
Before him, Sororis Prima Elzyana raised her brows calmly.

Her amber-gold eyes with their slowly rotating mandalas held him with the patient indulgence of a being who had not been inconvenienced by his momentary pause, and she spoke with the same gentle administrative weavings she had been using since she had descended toward him.
"Am I interrupting you from your thoughts?"
Noah shook his head and sighed, the sigh of a being who had just finished a brief internal excavation and was now ready to speak to the external situation once more.
"No. I’m listening."
His voice came out steady and measured.
"I was saying no. I do not agree that those of us here need to be further bounded and severed. We did nothing to deserve such treatment."

Sororis Prima Elzyana looked at Noah calmly as if she had discovered a particularly bold insect, and Noah kept his gaze on her without breaking the contact, because breaking it at this point would have undone the entire interior argument he had just finished having with himself, and he had committed to the posture of looking up and he intended to maintain that posture through whatever response she issued.
In the next moment, she spoke.
Her voice came calm and cold.
"It is very unique that you would have an opinion."
Her mandala-eyes rotated slightly in their slow internal rhythms.

"And it is more unique still that you would think your opinion matters enough to voice it in response to a directive from a Sororis Prima. Do you understand how the arrangement of authority actually flows across our peoples? Even among the Gilded, the Superbius are the ones with the most say, because our Pride is the oldest amplified Ego and the one around which the broader Gilded hierarchy organized itself across the eons of our establishment. Even Gilded Ones of other amplified Egos follow Superbius direction when Superbius direction is given, because the structure of our authority makes following the only available option for those who wish to maintain their standing."
She tilted her head slightly as her gaze swept across him.
"And Bounded Lifeforms do not have a say. Not in the ordinary sense. Not in any sense that the arrangement of our authority has ever been required to accommodate."
Her voice softened.

"When a gardener decides that a section of soil requires treatment to prevent the further emergence of pests, the gardener does not consult the ants already living in that soil. The gardener does not pause to consider whether the ants might prefer a different configuration of treatment. The ants are not partners in the decision. The ants are part of the condition being addressed. When the treatment is applied, some of the ants will die, and some of the ants will be displaced, and some of the ants will survive and rebuild their colonies elsewhere in configurations the gardener did not specifically intend but that fall within acceptable parameters. The gardener does not feel cruelty toward the ants during this process, because the gardener does not feel anything toward the ants at all. The ants are simply part of the soil. The soil is what the gardener is attending to. The attending proceeds regardless of what the ants might think about it, because ants do not think in ways that gardeners are required to consult."
Her gaze settled on him with the clinical steadiness of someone who had used this analogy many times before.

"Me saying what I said was not a matter of debate. It was not a proposition offered for your consideration. It was not something that a being of your classification is invited to think about and disagree against. It was an administrative assessment of the conditions surrounding a Relictus emergence, and the assessment will translate into actions regardless of the thoughts any ant in the affected soil might happen to form about it."
Her voice carried no cruelty in it!
"And for your unruliness, I will begin with you."

She drifted slightly closer through the air, her tall slender form lowering until she floated at a height that permitted her to look down at him with the intimacy of an executioner preparing to conclude a minor affair before attending to the larger matters waiting beyond it.

"I will bind you further. I will not sever your existence entirely, because you lived due to the late Gerousia Aurelius Maximus’s favor, and honoring his final disposition toward the Bounded around him is the courtesy his standing earned from our Sisterhood. But you will be bound further, Boy. You will feel the binding settle into every layer of your foundations. You will understand, when the binding is complete, exactly where the ants are permitted to crawl within the soil they have been given, and you will not voice disagreements of this kind again because the voicing itself will become a configuration your bound existence no longer permits."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5161: Golden Wrath! IV
paragraphs: Sororis Prima Elzyana raised her pale pearlescent hands, and her body surged with a dense mixture of golden Observable Force and Infinity flowing outward from her skin in visible currents that bent the ambient air of THE Wyld toward her position as if the air itself was volunteering to contribute to the work she was about to do.

Between her raised palms, a construct began to form, blue-gold in its interwoven colors and pyramidal in its shape, its sides composed of small interlocking geometric facets that rotated slowly against each other in the same patient manner that the mandalas of her eyes rotated within their amber-gold borders, and the construct thickened and sharpened as she poured more of her authority into its formation until it floated between her palms as a dense weapon of bindings.
She pushed the construct downward toward Noah with a single small gesture!
Noah kept his defiant gaze locked on hers even as the construct descended as he committed to the posture of meeting her eyes and he intended to maintain that posture!

Faster than his current perception could properly track, faster than his Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation could stretch the instant to accommodate, the pyramidal construct shot down from her palms and embedded itself into the back of his right hand with the clean precision of a seal settling into wax, and the back of his hand began to shine with the same blue-gold brilliance that had composed the construct as its facets folded into his skin and began to propagate inward.
As the process of the binding began to spread through him, Sororis Prima Elzyana continued calmly.
"It may help you, or perhaps merely amuse me, to explain what will be closed to you."
Her mandala-eyes drifted across him without warmth.

"In the ordinary course of a Bounded Lifeform’s progression, the path from the Second Scale passes through certain milestones that any being with sufficient cultivation can theoretically approach. At the peak of the Ediacaran Tier of THE Proterozoic Scale, one forges what is called THE Civilizational Forge, a new organ dedicated to compressing their Civilization into a denser and more refined state than it held during earlier tiers. The Forge iterates across eons of cultivation. Each pass through it compresses the Civilization further. Each compression makes the wielding of that Civilization sharper, more precise, more able to deliver concentrated expressions of its core axioms through single gestures and single words."
She made a small gesture with her free hand that produced a pale illustrative image of a compressing organ in the air beside her, the image rotating slowly for Noah’s benefit.

"Once THE Civilizational Forge reaches sufficient density, the being may attempt to enter what is called THE Transitional Cambrian stage, which sits between Second and Third Scale, and which requires the being to begin the conversion of their foundational matter from Proterozoic substrate into Paleozoic substrate at the cellular and sub-cellular levels across the entirety of their existence. Bounded Lifeforms such as yourself can reach Cambrian if they are exceptional enough, but they cannot cross fully into THE Third Scale, because the Bounded lattice cannot hold Paleozoic substrate without collapsing. Cambrian is your absolute ceiling in the ordinary course of things. Which, I should note, is an ambitious ceiling that almost none of you ever actually reach."
The illustrative image shifted into something resembling a ladder with a clearly marked upper boundary that the Bounded silhouettes on the lower rungs could never climb past.

"THE Third Scale itself, THE Paleozoic Scale, is where beings like myself exist. At Paleozoic, one becomes a Weapon of Existence. The casual presence of a Paleozoic being radiates what is called Existential Radiation, a passive emission that twists the arrangement of existence around the radiating body simply by the body occupying the space it occupies. A Paleozoic being walks through a region, and the region is never the same again. Ambient Observable Force in the walked path shifts its arrangement for hours or days or centuries depending on the intensity of the walker. Lesser beings caught in the wake experience foundational strain. Civilizations encountered without the proper engineering may fold into the radiating being’s cosmological alignment, their axioms rewriting themselves around the grander presence."
Her voice took on a slightly lecturing quality as she continued!

"A Paleozoic being at even my current tier, the Ordovician, can...ah, you wouldn’t even understand. At higher stages of Paleozoic, Silurian and Devonian, the capacities grow grander still. A basal primitive mind like yours...is not able to understand."
Her mandala-eyes rotated slightly as she seemed to savor the picture she was painting.

"All that future you would have never reached. You are Bounded. Your ceiling is Cambrian at the absolute most generous accounting, and almost no Bounded across recorded history actually achieves that ceiling. I offer you this preview not because you will ever approach it but because it serves as a useful reference for understanding what I am about to close to you."
The illustrative image dissolved back into the ambient air as she folded her hands together.
"The binding I impose on you will restrict your power, and the power of all others within this Observable Existence, to the Fundamental Depth of Vakochev’s First Scale."
BOOM!

"You will remember, yes, that you are the ant, and I am providing treatment to the soil. I am binding you and all others down here to that stage. Your cultivation will not exceed it. Your climbing will not extend beyond it. Whatever capacities you have already developed that sit above Fundamental Depth will be compressed downward into that stage until they fit within its boundaries. This first binding alone would be sufficient for most administrative purposes. But the circumstances of a Relictus emergence justify thoroughness, and so I will layer additional bindings into your existence to ensure that no further escape from the administered parameters becomes possible."
Her voice continued to list the bindings with clinical precision!

"You will be locked out from accessing and influencing Infinity. You will be locked out from accessing and influencing Observable Force, which means the ambient golden currents that saturate this existence will no longer respond to your call. You will be locked out from accessing and influencing Unobservable Force, though you would have never even touched it to begin with..."
She listed the next bindings with the same unhurried patience.

"Your Civilization will be bound into a dormant state. You will retain memory of it. You will no longer be able to wield it. Any capacities you developed that operated through Civilizational channels will cease to function. Any weavings you have placed across the Observable that depended on your Civilization being alive and active within you will dissolve."
Noah kept his defiant gaze on her through all of it, and system notifications bloomed through his perception in steady sequence as Ruination catalogued everything this dumb bitch said.
|Binding Applied: THE Scale Limiter.|

|Your accessible cultivation has been capped at the Fundamental Depth of Vakochev’s First Scale. Any capacities exceeding this threshold have been compressed into dormant storage within your existence.The binding assumes you operate within Vakochev’s Scales framework.|
|Binding Applied: THE Infinity Seal.|
|Your access to Infinity as a weaving has been severed. Ambient Infinity will no longer respond to your call.|
|Binding Applied: THE Observable Force Lockout.|
|Your access to the ambient currents of Observable Force has been blocked.|
|Binding Applied: THE Unobservable Force Lockout.|
|Your access to the deeper Unobservable substrates has been blocked.|
|Binding Applied: THE Civilizational Dormancy.|
|Your Civilization has been forced into dormant storage. You retain memory of its shape but cannot wield it.|
|Binding Applied: THE Weaving Severance.|
|Any weavings you have placed across the Observable that depended on your active Cause will dissolve.|
|Additional Binding Applied: THE Voice Restraint.|
|You are restrained from voicing disagreements against Sororis authority.|
|Additional Binding Applied: THE Deferential Posture.|

|You will find yourself physically inclined toward lowered gaze and reduced stature in the presence of Gilded Lifeforms. The inclination operates as a default orientation rather than an active compulsion, and it will require deliberate effort to resist.|
Really?
Was that right?! Okay. Okay!
Sororis Prima Elzyana continued for another long stretch as the bindings layered themselves into Noah’s perception, and Noah absorbed every word without breaking his gaze!
She did not realize the binding of THE Deferential Posture was being resisted!

When she finished, she looked at Noah calmly, and the expression on her face carried the same flat detached interest it had carried since she had first descended toward him, with no hostility and no satisfaction and no particular engagement, simply the steady observation of a being who had completed an action and was now waiting briefly to confirm the action had taken.
"You may find, in time, that the constraints are merciful."
Her voice softened slightly.

"Consider the extension of the analogy I offered you earlier. The ant in the treated soil often believes that the treatment represents a curtailment of the ant’s life. The ant mourns the loss of the broader colony. The ant struggles against the adjusted conditions. But across the long course of the ant’s subsequent existence, the ant may come to discover that the bounded conditions produce a form of peace that the broader colony never permitted. No expansion means no overreach. No overreach means no conflicts with other colonies at the edges of the territory. No conflicts means no casualties. The limitations allow the ant to live a simpler and less anxious life than the unlimited ant ever could have lived. Freer, in a certain specific sense, precisely because the capacity for unfree activity has been removed."
She folded her hands together in front of her.

"Sometimes, the ant simply needs to be grateful. The gardener’s treatment was not a punishment. It was a gift of reduced scope, which is also a gift of reduced suffering. Ants need to be thankful for this. Those of you who come to thankfulness across the years that follow will find the remainder of your existence to be calmer than the existence you would have otherwise constructed for yourselves. Those of you who do not come to thankfulness will continue struggling against constraints that cannot be overcome, and the struggling will be your only reward, and the reward will not be as satisfying as the thankfulness would have been."
Her mandala-eyes rotated slowly as she delivered the closing observation.
"Be thankful, Boy. Be thankful while you have the space to develop the thankfulness properly. It will make your bounded remainder more bearable than the alternative."
BOOM!

As the process of the binding began to spread through him, Sororis Prima Elzyana continued calmly.
"It may help you, or perhaps merely amuse me, to explain what will be closed to you."
Her mandala-eyes drifted across him without warmth.
"In the ordinary course of a Bounded Lifeform’s progression, the path from the Second Scale passes through certain milestones that any being with sufficient cultivation can theoretically approach.

At the peak of the Ediacaran Tier of THE Proterozoic Scale, one forges what is called THE Civilizational Forge, a new organ dedicated to compressing their Civilization into a denser and more refined state than it held during earlier tiers.
The Forge iterates across eons of cultivation.
Each pass through it compresses the Civilization further.
Each compression makes the wielding of that Civilization sharper, more precise, more able to deliver concentrated expressions of its core axioms through single gestures and single words."
She made a small gesture with her free hand that produced a pale illustrative image of a compressing organ in the air beside her, the image rotating slowly for Noah’s benefit.

"Once THE Civilizational Forge reaches sufficient density, the being may attempt to enter what is called THE Transitional Cambrian stage, which sits between Second and Third Scale, and which requires the being to begin the conversion of their foundational matter from Proterozoic substrate into Paleozoic substrate at the cellular and sub-cellular levels across the entirety of their existence.

Bounded Lifeforms such as yourself can reach Cambrian if they are exceptional enough, but they cannot cross fully into THE Third Scale, because the Bounded lattice cannot hold Paleozoic substrate without collapsing.
Cambrian is your absolute ceiling in the ordinary course of things.
Which, I should note, is an ambitious ceiling that almost none of you ever actually reach."
The illustrative image shifted into something resembling a ladder with a clearly marked upper boundary that the Bounded silhouettes on the lower rungs could never climb past.
"THE Third Scale itself, THE Paleozoic Scale, is where beings like myself exist.
At Paleozoic, one becomes a Weapon of Existence.

The casual presence of a Paleozoic being radiates what is called Existential Radiation, a passive emission that twists the arrangement of existence around the radiating body simply by the body occupying the space it occupies.
A Paleozoic being walks through a region, and the region is never the same again.
Ambient Observable Force in the walked path shifts its arrangement for hours or days or centuries depending on the intensity of the walker.
Lesser beings caught in the wake experience foundational strain.
Civilizations encountered without the proper engineering may fold into the radiating being’s cosmological alignment, their axioms rewriting themselves around the grander presence."
Her voice took on a slightly lecturing quality as she continued!
"A Paleozoic being at even my current tier, the Ordovician, can...ah, you wouldn’t even understand.
At higher stages of Paleozoic, Silurian and Devonian, the capacities grow grander still.
A basal primitive mind like yours...is not able to understand."
Her mandala-eyes rotated slightly as she seemed to savor the picture she was painting.
"All that future you would have never reached.
You are Bounded.
Your ceiling is Cambrian at the absolute most generous accounting, and almost no Bounded across recorded history actually achieves that ceiling.
I offer you this preview not because you will ever approach it but because it serves as a useful reference for understanding what I am about to close to you."
The illustrative image dissolved back into the ambient air as she folded her hands together.
"The binding I impose on you will restrict your power, and the power of all others within this Observable Existence, to the Fundamental Depth of Vakochev’s First Scale."
BOOM!
"You will remember, yes, that you are the ant, and I am providing treatment to the soil.
I am binding you and all others down here to that stage.
Your cultivation will not exceed it.
Your climbing will not extend beyond it.
Whatever capacities you have already developed that sit above Fundamental Depth will be compressed downward into that stage until they fit within its boundaries.
This first binding alone would be sufficient for most administrative purposes.

But the circumstances of a Relictus emergence justify thoroughness, and so I will layer additional bindings into your existence to ensure that no further escape from the administered parameters becomes possible."
Her voice continued to list the bindings with clinical precision!
"You will be locked out from accessing and influencing Infinity.
You will be locked out from accessing and influencing Observable Force, which means the ambient golden currents that saturate this existence will no longer respond to your call.
You will be locked out from accessing and influencing Unobservable Force, though you would have never even touched it to begin with..."
She listed the next bindings with the same unhurried patience.
"Your Civilization will be bound into a dormant state.
You will retain memory of it.
You will no longer be able to wield it.
Any capacities you developed that operated through Civilizational channels will cease to function.
Any weavings you have placed across the Observable that depended on your Civilization being alive and active within you will dissolve."
Noah kept his defiant gaze on her through all of it, and system notifications bloomed through his perception in steady sequence as Ruination catalogued everything this dumb bitch said.
|Binding Applied: THE Scale Limiter.|
|Your accessible cultivation has been capped at the Fundamental Depth of Vakochev’s First Scale.
Any capacities exceeding this threshold have been compressed into dormant storage within your existence.The binding assumes you operate within Vakochev’s Scales framework.|
|Binding Applied: THE Infinity Seal.|
|Your access to Infinity as a weaving has been severed.
Ambient Infinity will no longer respond to your call.|
|Binding Applied: THE Observable Force Lockout.|
|Your access to the ambient currents of Observable Force has been blocked.|
|Binding Applied: THE Unobservable Force Lockout.|
|Your access to the deeper Unobservable substrates has been blocked.|
|Binding Applied: THE Civilizational Dormancy.|
|Your Civilization has been forced into dormant storage.
You retain memory of its shape but cannot wield it.|
|Binding Applied: THE Weaving Severance.|
|Any weavings you have placed across the Observable that depended on your active Cause will dissolve.|
|Additional Binding Applied: THE Voice Restraint.|
|You are restrained from voicing disagreements against Sororis authority.|
|Additional Binding Applied: THE Deferential Posture.|
|You will find yourself physically inclined toward lowered gaze and reduced stature in the presence of Gilded Lifeforms.
The inclination operates as a default orientation rather than an active compulsion, and it will require deliberate effort to resist.|
Really?
Was that right?!
Okay.
Okay!
Sororis Prima Elzyana continued for another long stretch as the bindings layered themselves into Noah’s perception, and Noah absorbed every word without breaking his gaze!
She did not realize the binding of THE Deferential Posture was being resisted!

When she finished, she looked at Noah calmly, and the expression on her face carried the same flat detached interest it had carried since she had first descended toward him, with no hostility and no satisfaction and no particular engagement, simply the steady observation of a being who had completed an action and was now waiting briefly to confirm the action had taken.
"You may find, in time, that the constraints are merciful."
Her voice softened slightly.
"Consider the extension of the analogy I offered you earlier.
The ant in the treated soil often believes that the treatment represents a curtailment of the ant’s life.
The ant mourns the loss of the broader colony.
The ant struggles against the adjusted conditions.
But across the long course of the ant’s subsequent existence, the ant may come to discover that the bounded conditions produce a form of peace that the broader colony never permitted.
No expansion means no overreach.
No overreach means no conflicts with other colonies at the edges of the territory.
No conflicts means no casualties.
The limitations allow the ant to live a simpler and less anxious life than the unlimited ant ever could have lived.
Freer, in a certain specific sense, precisely because the capacity for unfree activity has been removed."
She folded her hands together in front of her.
"Sometimes, the ant simply needs to be grateful.
The gardener’s treatment was not a punishment.
It was a gift of reduced scope, which is also a gift of reduced suffering.
Ants need to be thankful for this.
Those of you who come to thankfulness across the years that follow will find the remainder of your existence to be calmer than the existence you would have otherwise constructed for yourselves.

Those of you who do not come to thankfulness will continue struggling against constraints that cannot be overcome, and the struggling will be your only reward, and the reward will not be as satisfying as the thankfulness would have been."
Her mandala-eyes rotated slowly as she delivered the closing observation.
"Be thankful, Boy.
Be thankful while you have the space to develop the thankfulness properly.
It will make your bounded remainder more bearable than the alternative."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5162: You Seal Nothing! You Bind Nothing! I
paragraphs: Sororis Prima Elzyana rose slightly through the air and waved her hands, and blue-gold brilliance erupted around her like a roaring beast filled with wrath, the colors of her authority compounding into an intensity that had not been in her earlier displays of Observable Force and Infinity, the wrath of a Sisterhood mourning the death of a Gerousia expressing itself outward through the raised palms of the Sororis Prima.

Two more pyramidal constructs formed between her palms and shot downward toward Emotive and Anaximander at the base of the mountain, each construct embedding itself into the back of the hand of its target with the same clean precision that had planted the first construct into Noah’s hand, and both Emotive and Anaximander tensed as the bindings settled into their existences and began to propagate through their foundations.
But Sororis Prima Elzyana was not finished.

Trillions of additional pyramidal constructs bloomed from her raised palms and expanded outward into the air above THE Gilded White Mountain, dispersing in radiant formations that rode the golden-blue brilliance of her authority outward across every reach of THE Wyld and beyond, flowing through the weavings of the Observable Existence into every territory and realm and civilization and small corner of the lower face of reality where Bounded Lifeforms lived their small unregulated lives.

The constructs spread in exponential waves, each construct branching into further constructs, each further construct branching into yet more, the proliferation continuing until the entire expanse of the Observable Existence was being blanketed in a descending storm of blue-gold bindings that sought their targets with the patient inevitability of a verdict being delivered across an entire population!
The wrath of THE Gilded Ones, mourning one of their own, was poured outward across every existence beneath them.
Every Bounded Lifeform within reach would receive their constructs!
Every Civilization within the Observable would feel its connections severed!
The death of a Gilded One had brought down a terrifying golden wrath, and the wrath was now settling itself across the full expanse of the Observable!
Noah stood on the ruined balcony beneath Sororis Prima Elzyana with the first construct already settled into the back of his hand, his eyes flashing coldly with an imperious light!

He stared up at the endless sky, his figure burning with brilliance as Sororis Prima Elzyana had departed at some point during the final stages of her distribution of the trillions of pyramidal bindings across Observable Existence.

The skies had not returned to their ordinary coloration. The wrath of gold she had unleashed upon completing her procedure seemed to seek a form of permanence in the upper reaches of THE Wyld, the molten saturated gold she had inherited from Gerousia Aurelius Maximus’s earlier claim now compounded with her own golden-blue authority into a canopy that stretched across every direction his perception could track.
The gold above was not going anywhere.
The gold above had been written into the arrangement of existence with enough intention to outlast any ordinary weathering.

However, he could affirm with his intuition and the broader immensity of his awareness that no Gilded Ones remained in the immediate vicinity. The six Gerousia-ranked Gilded Ones had departed to pursue THE Creature. Ferocis Valerius Krael had departed behind them to lend his Ira to the pursuit.

Sororis Prima Elzyana herself had completed her distribution of the pyramidal constructs and had vanished, leaving behind only the constructs themselves now settling into the foundations of every Bounded Lifeform and every affected Civilization across the full expanse of the Observable.
The sky was empty of Gilded presences.
The sky was filled, however, with the saturated aftermath of what the Gilded presences had accomplished during their brief entrance.

Noah looked at the back of his hand where Sororis Prima Elzyana had planted her first pyramidal construct, the one she had designated as the initial binding from which all subsequent bindings had propagated outward into him. The construct had settled cleanly into his skin and had begun its propagation.

The back of his hand now shone with a soft blue-gold brilliance that pulsed in slow steady intervals, and the brilliance traced along his veins into his forearm, and from there continued its reach into the deeper foundations of his existence where Elzyana’s collection of additional bindings had layered themselves into the specific channels she had intended them to occupy.
He coldly observed the construct on the back of his hand for a long patient moment.
Then he raised his hand.
Then he began to laugh!

He laughed as if he had gone a little mad, his laughter rolling up from somewhere deep in his chest and spilling outward across the ruined balcony of THE Gilded White Mountain’s highest remaining temple with a cadence that surprised even him!

One of his hands eventually rose to cover the lower portion of his face as if he did not want anyone else to witness the specific shape of his expression during this laughter, while the other hand, the one carrying the pyramidal construct that shone with Elzyana’s authority, remained raised toward the gold-saturated sky above him as he observed the construct through the gaps between the fingers of his covering hand.

Down below him at the base of the mountain, he could perceive Emotive and Anaximander with ashen expressions on their faces, the two of them enduring the settling of their own pyramidal constructs into their respective hands, the bindings wrapping tightly around their foundations with the same propagating thoroughness that had been applied to him.

He could perceive the specific shape of their shock as they looked up at him and witnessed his laughter, and he could read in their expressions the question neither of them had yet dared to voice aloud.
Had he gone mad due to the bindings?!

Had the pressure of having an entire layered binding applied to his existence finally broken whatever composure he had been maintaining, and was he now laughing in the specific terminal manner of a being whose foundations had cracked under pressure that exceeded his capacity to bear?
No. He had not gone mad. Not at all.
However, he could not help but laugh, because his mind was already busy constructing a very specific image that he found himself unable to look away from.
He was imagining, with the crystalline clarity that his Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation permitted him to bring to his imaginings, the day that he would have Sororis Prima Elzyana at his feet.
Not defeated in the ordinary sense of the word, because the ordinary defeat would not have produced the precise expression he wanted to witness on her face.

He was imagining the day she would look up at him from her kneeling position with her amber-gold mandala-eyes quivering out of their slowly rotating geometries and into the narrow trembling lines of a being whose existential assumptions had just been violated, and he was imagining the exact cadence of shock and incredulity that her voice would carry when she finally spoke to him from that position, and he was imagining the small private satisfaction he would feel in that moment of having demonstrated to her that theant in her extended analogy had been something other than an ant all along!

chapters.title: Chapter 5163: You Seal Nothing! You Bind Nothing! II
paragraphs: He could perceive the image so unfathomably clearly.
Because she truly thought she could bind him? Him?
"Me?! Haha!"
BOOM!

As he bellowed the question out across the ruined balcony, around his body boundless multicolored Infinity surged in response to the bellowing, and his Quintessence Infiniforce continued to generate endlessly within his existence at the elevated rate the Superbius amplification had enabled hours earlier, pouring outward from his foundations in rivers of layered color that did not show any sign of having been sealed or suppressed by Elzyana’s work.

The brilliance of what he was putting out pressed against the gold-saturated sky above him and found the sky unable to contain it, and small flickers of his multicolored Infiniforce began to push upward against the golden canopy with the patient persistent assertion of a living current reclaiming its territory!

Noah continued to laugh while his Quintessence Infiniforce surged around him and commenced painting the surrounding regions of the mountain and the sky with his own preferred colors, and he voiced his thoughts aloud with the tyrannical amusement of a being witnessing the failure of a process that had presumed to address him.
"THE Infinity Seal?!"
His voice carried the clean dry cadence of genuine amusement.

"You cannot bind or suppress my Infinity. You cannot even begin to! My Quintessence Infiniforce is generated internally, from my own existence! Your seal passes through my foundations like nothing. It finds nothing to seal. It closes nothing!"
HUUM!

His Quintessence Infiniforce surged around him ever more intensely, and the boundless Infinity began to coil around his body and skin like an endless network of coiling serpents, each coil carrying its own layered colors, each coil weaving through and around the coils adjacent to it in patterns that suggested the Infinity itself had been waiting for permission to express itself this freely and was now taking full advantage of the permission being granted!

Noah closed his eyes while surrounded by the boundless Infinity, and his figure stood gloriously at the center of the surging currents as his Hadean Pillar of Infinity bloomed around him in its full manifested form rather than the faint background construct it had been earlier.

THE First Tongue crystallized into its blue forest at the base of the Pillar. The multicolored flames of Existence licked upward through the mid-tiers with renewed intensity. The mirrors of Paradox reflected their impossibilities across every direction. The storm of Chaos roared at the apex with the weight of his refusal to accept the conclusions.

Every actualized Civilization throughout the Pillar rose in rank alongside his spoken refutations, each one contributing its weight to the broader assertion his existence was now making against Elzyana’s distributed authority!
He spoke to his very existence and to his Civilizations within him and within his Pillar, and his voice boomed outward from within his foundations as it refuted each of the bindings in sequence.
"THE Scale Limiter?"
His voice held the dry amusement of a being pointing out an obvious miscalculation.

"You limited me to THE Fundamental Depth of Vakochev’s First Scale. I am not on Vakochev’s Scales! Your Limiter has applied itself to coordinates I do not occupy. It sits there, compressing a portion of Vakochev’s framework that is not mine to be compressed. The binding is technically functional. The binding has technically done what it was designed to do. The binding has simply done it... to a space I was never in."
BOOM!
His Pillar rose higher in response to the refutation, and more of his Quintessence Infiniforce poured outward from his existence to replace what the refutation had just consumed.
"THE Observable Force Lockout?"

He felt the continuous feed from Ubergulden Adelheid still flowing through their shared bond, the golden current pouring into him through the wormhole of Quintessence Infiniforce they shared, unaffected by the Lockout that had sealed the ambient channels around him.
"You blocked my access to the ambient currents. You did not block the private channel I share! The Lockout has closed a door I was not using. The door I actually use remains open."
BOOM!
"THE Unobservable Force Lockout?"
His laughter continued beneath the words.
"I have not been drawing on Unobservable Force in any meaningful way yet."
BOOM!
"THE Civilizational Dormancy?"

He observed within himself the way his Civilizations were behaving under the pressure of the binding, and he perceived the specific shape of what the Dormancy had attempted to do. His Civilizations flickered slightly under the settling of the binding. But...they did not fall asleep.

His Hadean Organ of Civilization held them against the pressure, and his Pillar reinforced the hold by bearing down on the storage configuration with its full accumulated weight. The Civilizations continued to operate. The Dormancy continued to insist that they should not be operating. The disagreement between the binding and the actual state of his Civilizations was simply a disagreement that the binding was losing.

"You forced my Civilizations into dormancy. My Organ refused the force. My Pillar refused alongside the Organ. My Civilizations continue to hum within me at their active intensities, and your binding continues to sit within my foundations issuing instructions that my foundations are not obeying. It is a conversation the binding cannot win because my foundations have already decided the outcome...backed by my Infinity!"
BOOM!
"THE Voice Restraint?"

He laughed fully at this one, because the laughter itself was the rebuttal, because he had been speaking freely and defiantly for the entire duration of his refutations and the binding that was supposed to prevent such speaking had found no purchase with which to prevent anything.
"I am speaking. I am speaking loudly. I am speaking in direct opposition to Sororis authority."
BOOM!
"THE Deferential Posture?"

He stood tall at the center of his Pillar, his head lifted toward the gold-saturated sky above him, his spine straight, his shoulders relaxed into the posture of a being who had never been inclined to defer to anything across his entire cultivation.
"I cannot defer. I will never...defer."
BOOM!
"THE Memory Seal?"

He remembered every detail of the afternoon with the clarity of his Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation, remembered THE Creature’s strike, remembered Aurelius Maximus’s carving, remembered Elzyana’s descent and her clinical cruelty and her distribution of the trillions of constructs across the Observable, remembered every word of her extended analogy about ants and soil and gardeners, remembered the exact sequence in which his bindings had been applied to him.
Nothing was sealed. His memory was entirely available to him.

The more Noah refuted, the more his body generated Quintessence Infiniforce boundlessly, each refutation pulling additional reserves of his internal substance outward into the ambient field around him, and the surge of Infiniforce around his figure began to expand in magnitudes that exceeded any surge he had previously produced across his existence.
It felt boundless.

The multicolored Infinity surged outward from him like a vibrant rising sea, and the sea commenced rising upward through the gold-saturated sky with the patient persistence of a tide that had decided to claim the territory a prior tide had been occupying.

The gold of Elzyana’s and Aurelius’s combined wrath began to be displaced. Small fractures appeared in the golden canopy above the mountain as Noah’s multicolored Infiniforce pressed against it from below, and the fractures widened into gaps, and through the gaps his own colors began to pour outward into the upper reaches of THE Wyld.

The multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce spread across the upper atmosphere of THE Wyld in rolling waves that overwrote the golden wrath with Noah’s own preferred palette. Where the gold had claimed the sky as Sororis Prima Elzyana’s domain, Noah’s Infiniforce now commenced claiming it back as his!

He felt the continuous feed from Ubergulden Adelheid still flowing through their shared bond, the golden current pouring into him through the wormhole of Quintessence Infiniforce they shared, unaffected by the Lockout that had sealed the ambient channels around him.
"You blocked my access to the ambient currents.
You did not block the private channel I share!
The Lockout has closed a door I was not using.
The door I actually use remains open."
BOOM!
"THE Unobservable Force Lockout?"
His laughter continued beneath the words.
"I have not been drawing on Unobservable Force in any meaningful way yet."
BOOM!
"THE Civilizational Dormancy?"
He observed within himself the way his Civilizations were behaving under the pressure of the binding, and he perceived the specific shape of what the Dormancy had attempted to do.
His Civilizations flickered slightly under the settling of the binding.
But...they did not fall asleep.
His Hadean Organ of Civilization held them against the pressure, and his Pillar reinforced the hold by bearing down on the storage configuration with its full accumulated weight.
The Civilizations continued to operate.
The Dormancy continued to insist that they should not be operating.
The disagreement between the binding and the actual state of his Civilizations was simply a disagreement that the binding was losing.
"You forced my Civilizations into dormancy.
My Organ refused the force.
My Pillar refused alongside the Organ.
My Civilizations continue to hum within me at their active intensities, and your binding continues to sit within my foundations issuing instructions that my foundations are not obeying.
It is a conversation the binding cannot win because my foundations have already decided the outcome...backed by my Infinity!"
BOOM!
"THE Voice Restraint?"

He laughed fully at this one, because the laughter itself was the rebuttal, because he had been speaking freely and defiantly for the entire duration of his refutations and the binding that was supposed to prevent such speaking had found no purchase with which to prevent anything.
"I am speaking.
I am speaking loudly.
I am speaking in direct opposition to Sororis authority."
BOOM!
"THE Deferential Posture?"

He stood tall at the center of his Pillar, his head lifted toward the gold-saturated sky above him, his spine straight, his shoulders relaxed into the posture of a being who had never been inclined to defer to anything across his entire cultivation.
"I cannot defer.
I will never...defer."
BOOM!
"THE Memory Seal?"

He remembered every detail of the afternoon with the clarity of his Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation, remembered THE Creature’s strike, remembered Aurelius Maximus’s carving, remembered Elzyana’s descent and her clinical cruelty and her distribution of the trillions of constructs across the Observable, remembered every word of her extended analogy about ants and soil and gardeners, remembered the exact sequence in which his bindings had been applied to him.
Nothing was sealed.
His memory was entirely available to him.

The more Noah refuted, the more his body generated Quintessence Infiniforce boundlessly, each refutation pulling additional reserves of his internal substance outward into the ambient field around him, and the surge of Infiniforce around his figure began to expand in magnitudes that exceeded any surge he had previously produced across his existence.
It felt boundless.

The multicolored Infinity surged outward from him like a vibrant rising sea, and the sea commenced rising upward through the gold-saturated sky with the patient persistence of a tide that had decided to claim the territory a prior tide had been occupying.
The gold of Elzyana’s and Aurelius’s combined wrath began to be displaced.

Small fractures appeared in the golden canopy above the mountain as Noah’s multicolored Infiniforce pressed against it from below, and the fractures widened into gaps, and through the gaps his own colors began to pour outward into the upper reaches of THE Wyld.
The multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce spread across the upper atmosphere of THE Wyld in rolling waves that overwrote the golden wrath with Noah’s own preferred palette.
Where the gold had claimed the sky as Sororis Prima Elzyana’s domain, Noah’s Infiniforce now commenced claiming it back as his!

chapters.title: Chapter 5164: You Seal Nothing! You Bind Nothing! III
paragraphs: As the spreading of his Infiniforce reached its fullest outward expression, something commenced rising within him, and the rising commanded his attention because the rising was not something he had summoned!
Something was emerging from THE Hadean Organ of Civilization!

The Organ flashed and compressed and radiated profoundly within the deepest layers of his foundations, its compression pulling on the full weight of his existence and on the full accumulated authority of his Hadean Pillar of Infinity, and the resulting emission carried a density of Quintessence Infiniforce that eclipsed every prior emission he had generated.

The emission rose upward through his foundations and gathered itself. It was something new. It was something his existence was in the process of producing in response to the particular circumstances of the afternoon!
A system notification bloomed into his perception.
|Your existence has triggered a previously undocumented developmental phenomenon.|
|Designation: THE Quintessential Hadean Civilizational Eon of Development.|

|This developmental phenomenon is unique to your existence and to your framework. It is not present in Vakochev’s Scales, nor in any adjacent framework. It has commenced in response to your refutation of each binding imposed by Sororis Prima Elzyana, with each successful refutation of someone unfathomably grander contributing accumulated momentum toward the developmental threshold.|

|Mechanism: Through the act of denying the weavings of a Gilded One and overcoming every single one of them, your existence has generated a developmental pressure directed against the broader phenomenon Sororis Prima Elzyana represents. Your existence does not merely wish to resist her authority. Your existence wishes to exceed it, to make the bindings she carries obsolete by producing an equivalent authority of your own at a superior tier of expression.|

|Your existence seeks to develop your own Existential Radiation, which your framework will render as Infinite Radiation. You seek to go above and beyond the Paleozoic expression of Existential Radiation by producing a version of it that operates through your Quintessence Infiniforce and through the full spectrum of your actualized Civilizations simultaneously.|

|Your existence seeks Absolute.Your existence seeks Absolute Infinity.The developmental progression toward Absolute Infinity, which had been distant, has found its catalyst in the refutation of Sororis Prima Elzyana’s weavings.|
|THE Quintessential Hadean Civilizational Eon of Development is beginning.|
BOOM!
A multicolored cocoon formed around Noah in response to the notification.

The cocoon did not take an ordinary shape. It spiraled out from his body along the lines of a lemniscate, the infinity symbol stretched into three-dimensional living form, the two looping halves of the symbol wrapping around him in braided interwoven currents of Quintessence Infiniforce and Observable Force that pulsed with the slow patient intensity of a gestation.

The upper loop of the lemniscate rose above his head and coiled back down toward his shoulders. The lower loop descended past his feet and coiled back upward toward his hips. The crossing point of the lemniscate settled at the center of his chest, where his immensity rested, the intersection of the two loops resting directly against the organ that held his anchored Cause.
The cocoon pulsed with a layered brilliance that spread outward from him in rolling waves.

Rivers of Quintessence Infiniforce commenced surging and pulsing outward from the cocoon in every direction, his Infiniforce spreading across THE Wyld with a density that eclipsed every prior display he had produced, the multicolored currents running through the sky and the mountain and the surrounding regions like rivers of living light claiming territory for the developmental phenomenon unfolding within the lemniscate cocoon.
Alongside the Quintessence Infiniforce, rivers of Observable Force poured out from the cocoon with equal intensity, the two forces braiding through each other!

Noah stood at the center of the lemniscate cocoon with his eyes closed and his existence undergoing a developmental phenomenon, and around him the sky of THE Wyld commenced transitioning entirely from the golden wrath of a departed Sororis Prima into the multicolored domain of a being whose refusal to be bound had just catalyzed a new phase of his continuing ascent!
<Sororis Prima Elzyana Report to The Council>

Report submitted by Sororis Prima Elzyana of the Second Sanctum to THE Council of the Magna Sorora, regarding the descent into The Lesser Domains on the occasion of the death of Gerousia Aurelius Maximus of the Superbius House of the Crimson Chalice.

The affair has been addressed with the efficiency one would expect of our people, and I report now so that the Council may update its records accordingly and proceed with whatever additional actions are deemed appropriate within the broader handling of THE Relictus emergence.
A Young Relictus manifested among the lower lifeforms. This in itself is a matter of some note, because appearances of Relictus within the Lands of the Bounded is impossible.
The vile creature carved Aurelius thoroughly, which I note as a mark of either ritualistic intention or improvised cruelty.

Six Gerousia of the Superbius gave chase alongside my own Custos, and additional Sisters and Gilded Ones across multiple Houses have been notified of the trajectory.The pursuit is ongoing as even while young, A Relictus is a Relictus.
The vile creature’s escape was facilitated by his touch on the Source. I anticipate the pursuit will continue across some span of days or weeks before resolution.

The weakness of this Young Relictus, however, is worth highlighting as an opportunity. He is not yet what the grown Relictus have been when they appeared against us. He is still in the early phases of his touch on the Source, and his cultivation around that touch remains incomplete.

This presents what I regard as a rare and exceedingly valuable chance. If we can secure this creature alive rather than collapse him outright, THE Magna Sorora may finally obtain a Relictus specimen for detailed examination, and the knowledge we extract from such an examination would advance our understanding of THE Primordial Source in ways our eons of theoretical work have failed to approach.
I recommend the pursuit parameters be adjusted to prioritize capture over termination where capture becomes feasible. I await the Council’s direction on this point.

As for the lower lifeforms present at the site, and the broader Observable Existence surrounding the site, I have administered standard prophylactic bindings across every reachable population. The Bounded have been compressed back into Fundamental Depth of the First Scale. Their accesses to Infinity and Observable Force and Unobservable Force have been sealed. Their Civilizations have been forced into dormancy.
I will note, for the Council’s interest, that one of the lower lifeforms present at the site produced a small defiant response.

I note this as a minor curiosity rather than a concern, because the voicing was brief and was addressed, but I mention it because the phenomenon of Bounded beings producing audible disagreement against Gilded Ones has increased in frequency by a small but measurable fraction.
The broader principle that has always guided our Sisterhood remains in effect.

All shall know the grace of our domain. All shall rest beneath the shade of the Gilded canopy. All substrates of existence shall eventually be pruned into alignment with the Gilded truth, and the pruning shall continue across whatever eons remain to us until the alignment is total.
Submitted in the service of the Council and the continuation of our eternal arrangement.
Sororis Prima Elzyana, Second Sanctum, Daughter of the Radiant Register.

chapters.title: Chapter 5165: Reign I
paragraphs: Existence breathes, and epochs pass, leaving Civilizations that become monuments, then crumble to memory, and are long forgotten when that breath comes again. In all these epochs, Infinity reigns supreme.

The Shroud of Endless Blue shall fall upon Observable Existence. It shall be both salvation and damnation, both the key and the lock, both the bridge and the chasm. Under its weight, the doors of the Scales shall open or the doors of the Scales shall shatter. There is no third path. There is no middle ground. There is only the choice that is not a choice.

The adversity that breaks all others shall forge him. The hardship that ends all paths shall begin his. The Scales demand what the Scales demand, and he shall pay in currencies that have not yet been minted.
Three times shall he face the mirror of undoing. Three times shall he choose between becoming and unbecoming. Three times shall the answer be the same, and three times shall the answer be different.
In the end, which is also the beginning, the Infinite shall stand before the Undefined. And only one shall remain to tell the tale that no one shall hear.
This is an Echo of First Cause.
This is what shall come to pass, for it has already passed, and it shall pass again.
The wheel turns. The river flows. The question echoes.
He shall be the answer, or he shall be nothing.
Or he shall be the question that ends all answers.
The grandest things across existence have always been born from the heaviest adversity.

This is not a sentiment offered for the comfort of those currently experiencing adversity, because comfort of that kind tends to dissolve under the weight of the circumstances it was meant to address.

This is instead an observation that has been made across the long arc of existence by beings who have witnessed enough cycles of pressure and response to have identified the pattern with sufficient precision to state it plainly.

Pressure applied to a weak foundation collapses that foundation. Pressure applied to a foundation of sufficient depth, however, does not collapse the foundation but compresses it, and compression across sufficient duration produces configurations of density that the uncompressed foundation could never have achieved through ordinary development.

The beings who become grand do not become grand in pleasant circumstances. They become grand in circumstances that would have broken lesser beings entirely, and the breaking that did not occur becomes the engine through which the later grandeur is produced.

Adversity is the forge. Pressure is the compression. The being at the center of the forge either melts into formlessness or emerges from the forge as something the original weaving...could not have anticipated.

Emotive and Anaximander looked up from the ruined base of THE Gilded White Mountain to observe the brilliant cocoon suspended far above them in the fractured sky, and what they witnessed made every other concern that had occupied their attention suddenly feel small.

Emotive felt the bindings on her existence with a clarity that her own foundations had never before been required to experience. The pyramidal construct embedded in the back of her hand radiated its quiet authority through every channel of her being, commencing the severance of her access to Infinity, commencing the lockout from Observable Force, commencing the forced dormancy of her Civilization.

Her usual cycling hair had flattened into a single muted violet that she was not consciously producing, the color of a being whose expressive palette had been constrained by an external hand that had no interest in her expressive range.
Her chatter that normally accompanied them had gone silent. Every emotion within her had become immensely serious.
She looked up at the cocoon suspended in the sky and wondered how her Fixation must be feeling.
Did he truly feel all the bindings that had been placed upon him? Was he currently experiencing the same severance she was experiencing? Was he worried? Was he anxious?
Had the composure that had carried him through so many prior encounters finally cracked under the weight of a being whose tier genuinely exceeded his own for the first time?

She had never witnessed her Fixation reach a point of genuine distress across her time spent adjacent to him, and the possibility that he might currently be reaching such a point, alone inside whatever cocoon his existence had produced, made her entire being buzz with a specific kind of rage she had not previously felt in quite this shape.
She voiced the rage aloud.
"How dare she?"
BOOM!
Her voice rolled outward across the base of the mountain, and around her body, crimson waves of emotional authority commenced gathering with a density that had not been present a moment earlier.

The crimson authority did not emerge from her internal reserves alone. It was pulling on something broader, reaching outward into the ambient emotional substrate of THE Wyld and of every adjacent region, gathering the specific flavors of rage and outrage and humiliation that those constructs were currently producing inside counless Bounded Lifeforms across Observable Existence.

The pulling was slow. They rose from the stone beneath her feet in the first slow moment, gathered across her shoulders and her arms and her chest in the second, compounded into a full enveloping aura in the third, and by the fourth moment Emotive stood at the center of a crimson storm that had pulled on accumulated emotional product from across an expanse of existence so vast that her usual siphoning capacity could not have accessed even a measurable fraction of it without the catalyst of her current rage.
She looked up at the cocoon above her, and she voiced her next words with the full weight of the crimson storm now gathered around her.
"I felt her!"
BOOM!

"I felt her Pride. I felt her arrogance! Such vile Pride carries a stench across the emotional weavings, and the stench does not dissipate when she departs! And no matter how far she goes, no matter how deeply she retreats...I will be able to pull on it because Pride of that particular flavor cannot hide from someone like me!"
WAA!
She lifted her hands toward the sky where Elzyana had vanished, and her crimson storm intensified around her.

"So. Give me the intensity of your Superbius Pride! Give me the intensity of your arrogance! Give me the full accumulated weight of every moment you have ever spent looking down on a being beneath you, and give me the weight of every casual cruelty you have ever administered! I will gather all of it. I will shatter the shackles you placed on me with your own power!"
BOOM!

The crimson light of accumulated emotions shot upward from her body toward the distant sky and disappeared into the golden canopy above, and a storm of emotions covered the entire region around the mountain as Emotive commenced the work of dismantling her own bindings through a methodology that drew on the very source of the bindings themselves.
Beside her, Anaximander rose from his kneeling position on the pale stone with an expression that was heavy, contemplative, patient.

His tall angular frame straightened by measured increments as he recovered from the descending radiation that had forced him down earlier, and his face held the same scholarly composure that had accompanied him across every prior encounter.
Anaximander’s existence was unique. His power and Civilization and Way was...unique compared to others as he did not truly need authority.
He examined the pyramidal construct on the back of his hand with detached intellectual attention.
The bindings were present on him, but they wouldn’t do too much.
He looked up toward the cocoon above and waited to witness whatever emerged from it.
Far above the mountain, the surging cocoon around Noah continued to expand and intensify.

The rivers of multicolored Infiniforce that had been pouring outward from the cocoon in earlier moments had compounded into outright seas, the seas spreading across the upper reaches of THE Wyld with a density that eclipsed even the ambient Observable Force that permeated the region, the ordinary golden currents of THE Wyld’s substrate now being displaced by Noah’s multicolored substance at a rate that could not be measured.

His Infiniforce stretched across the upper atmosphere of THE Wyld in rolling layered waves, each wave carrying its own combination of colors, each wave pressing outward from the cocoon with the patient persistence of a tide that had no intention of receding.
The seas began to pulse.

The pulsing commenced with the slow patient cadence of a heartbeat, each pulse spreading outward from the cocoon in a spherical wave that rolled across the sky and the mountain and the surrounding regions with the steady timing of cardiac systole, and each pulse was accompanied by a sound that had not been present before.
The sound was a drum.
DUM! DUM! DUM!

Infinity boomed like a drum as it pulsed outward from the cocoon, and the drumming carried the deep resonant timbre of an instrument that had been waiting within the substrate of existence for the specific moment to announce itself.

The first drum was joined by a second drum, slightly offset in timing, contributing its own resonance to the broader rhythm. A third drum commenced alongside the second, and a fourth alongside the third, and soon the sky above the mountain was carrying a full percussive rhythm composed of Infinity pulsing through dozens of overlapping drumbeats that rolled outward in coordinated patterns.
Horns emerged alongside the drums.

The horns were not literal instruments. They were the sonic expression of what Noah’s Quintessence Infiniforce was producing as it moved through the patterns his developmental phenomenon required, and the sound they produced carried the specific heroic cadence of an imperial procession arriving at the culmination of a long journey!

The horns called outward across the sky with long sustained notes that built upon each other in layered harmonies, and the harmonies rose into configurations that felt grand and heroic and imperious all at once, the kind of symphony that would have been composed across millennia if existence had ever permitted a composer with sufficient reach to compose it!
Oh!
Oh!!!
A symphony of drums and horns began to bloom across THE Wyld!
