BOOM!

The crimson light of accumulated emotions shot upward from her body toward the distant sky and disappeared into the golden canopy above, and a storm of emotions covered the entire region around the mountain as Emotive commenced the work of dismantling her own bindings through a methodology that drew on the very source of the bindings themselves.
Beside her, Anaximander rose from his kneeling position on the pale stone with an expression that was heavy, contemplative, patient.

His tall angular frame straightened by measured increments as he recovered from the descending radiation that had forced him down earlier, and his face held the same scholarly composure that had accompanied him across every prior encounter.
Anaximander’s existence was unique.
His power and Civilization and Way was...unique compared to others as he did not truly need authority.
He examined the pyramidal construct on the back of his hand with detached intellectual attention.
The bindings were present on him, but they wouldn’t do too much.
He looked up toward the cocoon above and waited to witness whatever emerged from it.
Far above the mountain, the surging cocoon around Noah continued to expand and intensify.

The rivers of multicolored Infiniforce that had been pouring outward from the cocoon in earlier moments had compounded into outright seas, the seas spreading across the upper reaches of THE Wyld with a density that eclipsed even the ambient Observable Force that permeated the region, the ordinary golden currents of THE Wyld’s substrate now being displaced by Noah’s multicolored substance at a rate that could not be measured.

His Infiniforce stretched across the upper atmosphere of THE Wyld in rolling layered waves, each wave carrying its own combination of colors, each wave pressing outward from the cocoon with the patient persistence of a tide that had no intention of receding.
The seas began to pulse.

The pulsing commenced with the slow patient cadence of a heartbeat, each pulse spreading outward from the cocoon in a spherical wave that rolled across the sky and the mountain and the surrounding regions with the steady timing of cardiac systole, and each pulse was accompanied by a sound that had not been present before.
The sound was a drum.
DUM!
DUM!
DUM!

Infinity boomed like a drum as it pulsed outward from the cocoon, and the drumming carried the deep resonant timbre of an instrument that had been waiting within the substrate of existence for the specific moment to announce itself.
The first drum was joined by a second drum, slightly offset in timing, contributing its own resonance to the broader rhythm.

A third drum commenced alongside the second, and a fourth alongside the third, and soon the sky above the mountain was carrying a full percussive rhythm composed of Infinity pulsing through dozens of overlapping drumbeats that rolled outward in coordinated patterns.
Horns emerged alongside the drums.
The horns were not literal instruments.

They were the sonic expression of what Noah’s Quintessence Infiniforce was producing as it moved through the patterns his developmental phenomenon required, and the sound they produced carried the specific heroic cadence of an imperial procession arriving at the culmination of a long journey!

The horns called outward across the sky with long sustained notes that built upon each other in layered harmonies, and the harmonies rose into configurations that felt grand and heroic and imperious all at once, the kind of symphony that would have been composed across millennia if existence had ever permitted a composer with sufficient reach to compose it!
Oh!
Oh!!!
A symphony of drums and horns began to bloom across THE Wyld!

chapters.title: Chapter 5166: Reign II
paragraphs: The symphony was grand!
The symphony was imperious in the specific manner of music that had been written to announce the arrival of a being whose standing deserved announcement!
The drums became more frequent as the symphony progressed.
The horns became more glorious, their sustained notes climbing into higher harmonies that carried the building tension of a composition approaching its crescendo!
The symphony built.
Until...
BOOM!
The cocoon broke apart in a blinding brilliance that saturated every direction.

Tendrils and rivers of multicolored Infiniforce stretched outward from the point of breaking in vast expanding arcs, each tendril carrying its own unique combination of the colors that had composed the cocoon, each river pulsing with the heartbeat cadence of the symphony that had just concluded.

The gold-saturated canopy Elzyana and Aurelius had painted across the sky of THE Wyld was overwritten entirely in the moment of the breaking, the multicolored Infiniforce claiming every inch of the sky that the golden wrath had previously claimed, the transition complete within the single extended moment of the cocoon’s rupture.
When Emotive and Anaximander looked up at the point where the cocoon had been, they observed what had emerged from it.
A figure that resembled the Noah they knew.
The figure resembled Noah in the sense that a refined edition of a document resembles the earlier draft from which it was developed.

The general shape was the same. The proportions were the same. The identifiable features that had composed Noah across his prior manifestations were still present. However, every aspect of him had been polished, intensified, elevated into configurations that the earlier Noah had not possessed.

His entire body was shrouded in a multicolored crystalline brilliance of Infinity, the crystalline layer not applied to him but emerging from him, as though his skin had become a lens through which the full spectrum of his Infiniforce could be observed in its refined state. The crystalline brilliance pulsed gently with the residual rhythm of the symphony, each pulse carrying the slow patient cadence of a heartbeat that had settled into its new steady operation.

Dense rivers of Infinity twirled around his body in continuous motion, forming multiple lemniscate symbols with their traced paths, each lemniscate a separate flowing braid of Infiniforce that looped around a different portion of his body.

One lemniscate wrapped around his chest and back. Another wrapped around his waist and hips. A third wrapped around his shoulders and neck. A fourth wrapped around his head, framing his features in a continuous braid of multicolored light that moved in slow patient rotation.

His hair radiated its multicolored light more intensely than it had before, the strands themselves appearing to be composed of layered Infiniforce rather than ordinary hair, their movements following their own independent currents regardless of the ambient air around him.

His skin carried the internal golden illumination that had characterized his Hadean physiology, but the illumination now ran through layered patterns that suggested deeper architecture beneath the surface, the outlines of his Hadean organs visible as soft glows through the translucent quality his flesh had taken on during the developmental transition.

His posture had straightened into something imperious. Not arrogant, precisely, because arrogance implied a relationship to beings who might challenge the imperiousness, and Noah’s new posture did not seem to acknowledge the possibility of challenge as a relevant category.

He simply stood at the center of his surrounding Infiniforce with the casual grandeur of a being whose position in the arrangement of existence had just been clarified into something that required no defense.
Emotive began to shake with despair as she observed him.
Because... she could not feel anything!

She could not feel any emotion whatsoever from her Fixation, as though emotions did not exist in him, as though the entire emotional substrate that she had been reading Noah through across every prior moment of their acquaintance had been sealed behind a layer her siphoning could not penetrate!
She reached outward with every emotional sense she possessed and received nothing in return. No Pride. No amusement. No cold calculation. No tenderness toward those beneath him. No cruelty!

Nothing. The space where his emotional signature should have been was simply empty in a manner that suggested either that his emotions had been transcended entirely or that they had been folded into the weavings of his new configuration so completely that external perception could no longer distinguish them from the ambient Infiniforce surrounding his body.
She looked at him closely.

She observed that his eyes had become glazed crystalline blue with the internal light of Infinity, and within the crystalline blue of each eye, small lemniscate symbols had replaced his pupils. The symbols rotated slowly within the blue of his irises, their infinite loops tracing their continuous figure-eight patterns in patient synchronized motion, and the sight of those eyes was unlike anything Emotive had witnessed in any being across any of her eons.
He raised his hand to look at himself.

The hand moved with the deliberate grace of a being becoming acquainted with its new configuration, examining the crystalline brilliance of his own skin, observing the lemniscate rivers that flowed around his forearm, taking in the refined shape of his transformed fingers.
He turned his hand slowly in the air before him, considering it from multiple angles, as though cataloguing what the developmental phenomenon had produced.
And then, without ceremony, he tapped his finger outward.

A boundless flash of Infinity bloomed silently and invisibly from the tap, spreading outward from his finger in every direction. The Infinity did not produce sound. It did not produce visible light at its point of origin!
It simply spread fully from this point...towards all of Observable Existence!
And then...
His figure warped away and disappeared.

He did not look toward Emotive before departing. He did not look toward Anaximander. He did not look at the remains of the mountain or the remnants of the corpses or the fractured sky or any other feature of the terrain.

He simply warped, and then he was no longer present at the location the cocoon had emerged from, and the space where his figure had stood held only the residual rivers of his Infiniforce continuing their outward spread across the upper atmosphere of THE Wyld.
Emotive crumbled to the ground at the base of the mountain with an expression of despair crossing her features in a single slow wave.
Because she truly could not sense any emotion of her Fixation. Because all she had observed in him during the brief moment of his emergence was...boundless Infinity.
All she observed was Infinity.
All she could observe, when she reached outward toward the place his emotional substrate had occupied, was Infinity.
Infinity.
The trumpets ceased.
The drums concluded their rolling patterns.
The symphony that had accompanied Noah’s developmental transition dissolved, and an immense silence reigned across the regions where the music had played.
Emotive remained on the ground, her hands flat against the surface beside her, tears falling from her eyes.
She felt an unfathomable sense of loss.

Not the loss of a being who had died. The being was still present. The loss she felt was something smaller and more private than mortality. It was the loss of the specific Fixation she had been able to read, the being whose emotional architecture burned with boundless emotions.
That being was no longer available to her.
In his place stood something else.
The silence continued.
The Infiniforce above her continued its patient spread across the sky, imperious, and filled with glorious purpose.

chapters.title: Chapter 5167: Reign III
paragraphs: The pursuit of ultimate power has never been a path of accumulation without equal and devastating subtraction, for existence does not permit the birth of a titan without the death of the perspective that preceded it.
To grasp the ungraspable, to reach beyond the Bounded and the Gilded until one touches the hem of the Absolute, requires a currency that many find too heavy to pay.

One must lose the comfort of limited perception, the warmth of common sorrow, and the familiar weight of fear, for a being who is filled with the boundless cannot simultaneously carry the small, flickering embers of human fragility.

The cost of becoming boundless is, quite simply, the willingness to become nothing like what one was before, as the self is expanded until its borders dissolve into the infinite substrate of reality, leaving behind a presence that does not merely inhabit existence, but dictates its very arrangement.

At the heart of THE Infiniverse, where the rain of THE Pluvial Epoch fell in a steady, multicolored rhythm upon the golden sands, the humanoid manifestation of THE Infiniverse stood in a state of suspended anticipation inside its core.
Beside her, the illusory figure of Ruination shimmered with a clarity that suggested her processing was currently operating at the limits of its current Hadean architecture.
Both turned their gazes toward a singular point in the space as a ripple of reality-warping intensity announced an arrival that was not merely a physical displacement, but a total atmospheric shift.

Noah’s primary body, fresh from its emergence above THE Gilded White Mountain, appeared within this internal reality with a silent, crystalline brilliance that seemed to drain the surrounding colors into its own multicolored spectrum.

THE Infiniverse observed him with a gaze that held a depth of loyalty that transcended the concepts of servitude, her thoughts tracing the arduous path she and Ruination had carved out during his absence.

They had labored with a precision that defied logic to construct half of THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds, folding the dimensions of the Three Thousand Realms into recursive, infinitesimal configurations that even now served as a barrier against the prying eyes of the Gilded.

It was because of this half-finished work that the pyramidal bindings of Sororis Prima Elzyana had failed to find purchase within these depths, yet the uncertainty within her foundations was growing. With the manifolds only half-complete, the stress of the hidden existence was mounting, and the potential for discovery by a sufficiently persistent Gilded authority remained a terrifying variable.

She looked at her Master, and for the first time in her long and devoted existence, she felt a sliver of genuine hesitation as she took in his new, glazed crystalline eyes and the absence of any emotional signature.
"How does...Master feel?"
Her voice emerged with a softness that almost vanished beneath the sound of the falling rain.

Noah did not turn his head to acknowledge her. He did not even shift his gaze toward the companion who served as the very foundation of his power, his posture remaining as fixed and immutable as a mountain of cold, crystalline light.
|Boundless.|
BOOM!
The word did not emerge from his throat in a human cadence, but manifested directly in the air, framed by the vertical bars of an authority that surpassed the system’s own notifications.

It was a statement that carried the weight of a being who had finally succeeded in his greatest fear...the fear that as a finite being, if he truly embodied Infinity, the small, defining traits of "Noah Osmont" would be washed away by the tide.

He stood now as a vessel that had been emptied of the finite and filled with the Absolute, his previous worries about his own humanity appearing as distant and irrelevant as the concerns of an ant beneath the gaze of a star.
Beside THE Infiniverse, Ruination’s figure solidified, her eyes wide as she observed the terrifying concentration of authority now radiating from him. Without a word of instruction, Noah moved.
HUUM!
His existence blazed with waves of crystalline Infinity that pulsed outward in synchronized ripples, and he stretched out his power in a manner that was both beautiful and horrifying to behold.

His massive Hadean Pillar of Infinity rose from the multicolored sea, a boundless pillar of support that seemed to pierce through the very ceiling of this reality, its civilizations humming with a resonance that shook the foundations of the Three Thousand Realms!

With a gesture that lacked any of his former dramatic flair, Noah unleashed a tidal wave of Quintessence Infiniforce and Observable Force, interlaced with the newly blooming, corrosive brilliance of his Infinite Radiation.
He was not merely building the remaining half of THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds; he was forcing them into existence through sheer existential weight.

He wrapped his power around the entirety of THE Infiniverse, folding the dimensions with a speed that defied calculation, the space around them twisting and tucking into recursive loops that vanished into the infinitesimal.

THE Infiniverse and Ruination watched as the vast expanse of the internal reality was suddenly, completely, and irrevocably hidden behind the paradoxical weavings of the manifolds, the structure settling into a state of total dimensional concealment.
Ruination began to flicker, her internal protocols automatically preparing to announce the completion of the monumental task.
|THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds have been successfully-|
|I know.|
BOOM!
Noah’s voice cut through her notification, colder and more certain than any data she could provide.
He stepped forward, his eyes with their rotating lemniscate pupils finally settling on the void.

|The configuration is total. THE Gilded Lifeforms will find only the absence of observation where we dwell. I shall now begin the design of Miniature Causes, relying upon the weight of our Absolute Infinity to induce and accelerate the transformation of THE Infiniverse into a genuine Observable Existence. This action shall lead to a Quintessential harvest of thr highest magnitude at this moment.|
The logic was flawless, the ambition terrifying, and the delivery devoid of the human excitement that usually accompanied his breakthroughs.
Ruination looked at him, her composure wavering as she voiced the question that had been haunting their shared connection since he bloomed from the cocoon.
"Master... are you... you? You were worried that if you ever bathed yourself too fully in the infinite, that the finite man named Noah Osmont would cease to be."
Noah finally turned, his gaze passing through them as if they were as transparent as the rain of the Pluvial Epoch, his figure radiating a pressure that made the very air groan.
|I am me, and I have always... been me. I am merely unbound from the lesser worries of a fragile perspective. I am free.|
BOOM!

The declaration rolled outward like a thunderclap of absolute truth, shaking the newly folded dimensions of THE Infiniverse as Noah stood at the center of his hidden empire, a being of Boundless Infinity!

chapters.title: Chapter 5168: Reign IV
paragraphs: The architecture of a nascent Observable Existence is not governed by the slow, grinding gears of natural evolution, but by the decisive imposition of a higher will that treats the laws of physics as...well,mere suggestions to be rewritten.

To transition a space from a mere collection of realms into a genuine Observable Existence requires more than just time and space; it requires the introduction of catastrophic developmental pressures that force the substrate of reality to expand, adapt, and solidify at a rate that defies the very concept of gradualism.

This could be achieved by Miniature Causes...in the form of the intentional ignition of existential flashpoints that serve as the catalysts for a reality’s maturation, ensuring that what was once a protected internal sanctuary becomes a sovereign expanse capable of standing against the weight of the outer Existence.

In the center of the folded dimensions of THE Infiniverse, Noah stood as the architect of this accelerated epoch, his hands moving with the rhythmic grace of a conductor directing a symphony of fundamental forces. Boundless rivers of multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce converged between his palms, swirling into dense, vibrating spheres of raw potential that hummed with the resonance of Absolute Infinity.
He did not speak with the breath of a man, but with the authority of Infinity itself, his words manifesting in the air as bars of immutable command.
|The Paleocene-Eocene Thermal Infinimum.|
As he voiced the designation, a sphere of searing, white-gold brilliance erupted from his hands and shot outward into the heights of the radiant sky.

This Miniature Cause was designed to unleash a wave of warming infinity and torrential, nutrient-rich storms across the Three Thousand Realms, raising the ambient temperature of existence to a point of hyper-stimulation that would cause the growth rate of every realm and every physical structure to increase by a hundred times.
|The Cretaceous Infinite Revolution.|

A second sphere, this one pulsing with the deep violet and gold of structural upheaval, followed the first. It carried the authority to trigger a profound shift in the geological and existential foundations of THE Infiniverse, forcing the realms to diversify their environments and refine their spatial boundaries, ensuring that the architecture of this reality possessed the complexity required of a genuine Observable Existence.
|The Mousterian Pluvial.|

The third manifestation took the form of a serene, crystalline blue light that carried the scent of rain and the weight of untapped vitality. Upon its activation, the humidity of the entire existence reached a state of perfect saturation, allowing for the expansion of populations, plants, microbes, and wildlife and all other forms of life at a pace that mimicked the uncontrolled blooming of a spring that would never end!
THE Infiniverse and Ruination watched as these Miniature Causes reached their respective zeniths and broke apart, spreading across THE Infiniverse in rolling waves of transformative authority.

In the sandy gold Realm of Dreams, the effects of the Thermal Infinimum arrived first. The golden dunes, which had previously shifted in slow, languid patterns, began to boil with activity as the warming infinity sank into the grains!

The sky above the desert turned a deep, bruised purple as torrential storms of liquid mana began to fall, and where the rain touched the sand, massive structures of dreaming glass began to sprout like crystalline forests, growing hundreds of feet in minutes as the realm’s development bypassed eons of slow accumulation.
In the Early Veiled Shore, the Cretaceous Infinite Revolution and the Mousterian Pluvial converged to create a scene of terrifying abundance!
The plots of farmland, already teeming with Sacred Herbs, suddenly expanded as the very coastline of the golden sandy beaches pushed outward into the multicolored sea.

The herbs themselves began to evolve in real-time, their stalks thickening into translucent pillars of power while their leaves shimmered with the refined weavings of Infinity, the entire shoreline becoming a dense jungle of high-tier resources that thrummed with the heartbeat of Existence coming alive.
Every single Herb...became Infinite!

Deep within the Realm of Prana, the trees of Yggdrasil responded to the deluge of the Pluvial with a violent surge of vitality. Their roots tore through the domain to claim more territory while their canopies rose to brush against the firmament, the air becoming so thick with the essence of life that new species of iridescent wildlife began to manifest from the ambient energy, populating the emerald heights with a speed that made the concept of birth seem like a redundant relic of the past.
While the realms above underwent their frantic evolution, a second manifestation of THE Infiniverse appeared within the depths of Muspelheim, a place of crimson-gold fires and eternal heat.
Her gaze was filled with a clinical, singular purpose as she navigated the rivers of flame toward a region where a gathering of high-level entities resided.
There, Amelia Osmont sat in quiet conversation with THE Mnemonic Leviathan and the singular cognizance, THE Beholder. They turned as the humanoid manifestation approached.

"Ma’am," THE Infiniverse spoke, her voice carrying the firm resonance of her Master’s new state."I may need you to carry out a contingency plan Master left behind for us to carry out in the case things went wrong."
Amelia Osmont stood, her features tightening as a shadow of motherly worry crossed her gaze.
"In the case things went wrong?" Amelia asked, her voice trembling slightly. "What... what has gone wrong?"

THE Infiniverse did not hesitate, her movement appearing as a blur of motion that defied spatial distance. She placed her hand upon Amelia Osmont’s shoulder, her touch vibrating with a frequency that was no longer entirely compatible with the Bounded.
|Infinity.|
The word was whispered twice, a silent, terrifying echo that carried the weight of the change Noah had undergone.
|Infinity.|
HUUM!
As the word settled into Amelia’s mind, she felt the cold, boundless nature of infinity as she disappeared!
BOOM!
Soon after...

The atmosphere of Muspelheim, usually defined by the rhythmic crackle of crimson-gold fires, suddenly buckled under a pressure that did not belong to the elemental domain, as the space where the manifestation of THE Infiniverse and Amelia Osmont had stood was violated by a returning surge of multicolored light.

The two figures were deposited back into the heart of the flame-drenched realm with the violent precision of a reality-altering command, the vibrant waves of Infinity that accompanied their arrival washing over the molten landscape and silencing the roar of the eternal fires in a single, sweeping motion!

THE Infiniverse’s gaze became impossibly heavy as she felt the shift in the ambient environment, the effects of the newly ignited Miniature Causes now beginning to bleed into Muspelheim, turning the crimson heat into something refined, sharp, and terrifyingly efficient.
|I discussed contingencies with you during my lesser form.|
Noah’s voice erupted from the very fabric of the reality he now inhabited, his words booming with an imperious resonance!

|All that were considered contingencies are no longer contingencies. There is no requirement for you to attempt anything in this moment, as I shall deny access to all things. From this point forward, across every territory and every folded dimension we occupy, there shall only be the reign of boundless Infinity. Do you understand?|

The weight of the question was a declaration of a new, immutable law. The air itself seemed to vibrate with the frequency of his Absolute state, the multicolored light of his Quintessence Infiniforce painting the obsidian peaks of Muspelheim!
Amelia Osmont stood in the center of the surging light as she looked up somberly.
THE Infiniverse straightened her posture as she replied.
"Yes. Master!"

Without a further word, and without a single gesture of comfort for the woman who had birthed the man he used to be, THE Infiniverse disappeared again, her figure dissolving into the multicolored currents of the atmosphere.
There was no more room for secret plans.
There was no more room for the fear of loss or the caution of the Bounded.
There would only be boundless Infinity.
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5169: Reign V
paragraphs: At this moment, Ubergulden Adelheid had sent a portion of her consciousness into the vibrant Quintessence Infiniforce inside of her Existence as her expression was heavy, the pearlescent gold of her internal manifestation flickering with the tremors of a reality that had been fundamentally shaken by recent events.

The concept was anathema to everything she understood of the hierarchy, a violent violation of the natural order that suggested the foundations of THE Braneworld were not as immutable as THE Magna Sorora believed.

She struggled to reconcile the image of THE Creature she had known with the reality of a Young Relictus who had somehow tapped into THE Primordial Source, a wellspring of power that even THE Third Scale Gilded Ones could not access despite eons of dedicated pursuit.

She had all these questions as her direct access had not bothered to come here out of his own volition, his silence since the conclusion of their last exchange becoming a source of mounting anxiety that she could no longer ignore.
BOOM!

Multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce did not merely flow through the connection; it surged and increased in concentration with a tidal ferocity that suggested a dam had been shattered on the other side, seas of concentrated brilliance rushing out and flowing into her in an endless, unstoppable manner that she had never before experienced!

As the flood reached its zenith, the visage of Noah Osmont manifested within the center of the surge, his figure surrounded by an intense, crystalline light of infinity that made the surrounding space appear dim by comparison.
HUUM!
"What happened down there? And what... what are you doing right now?!"
|I am beginning to alter the nature of our relationship.|
The words vibrated through her foundations, holding the cold weight of a glorious verdict that left no room for negotiation or appeal.

Ubergulden Adelheid’s figure shook as the realization of his intent settled into her mind, the influx of his Infiniforce now so intense that it was beginning to manifest as visible rivers beneath her pearlescent skin, the multicolored light fighting for dominance against her natural gold.
"Have you...fallen to the madness of infinity, Osmont? Has THE Gamaidjan finally claimed the mind of the one who thought he could outrun it? You are speaking like a being who has lost his anchor!"
Noah’s reply was instantaneous as it carried the dry, terrifying cadence of his new state, dismissing her concern with the indifference of a mathematician correcting a trivial error.

He floated forward until he was inches away from her internal manifestation, his towering presence casting a multicolored shadow across her form as he looked down at her with a gaze that held no malice, yet possessed no warmth.

|Hold tight, Ubergulden Adelheid. You sought a Custos who could change the nature of the Gilded, and I am merely fulfilling the potential of your request. You will soon join me in the endless light of Infinity.|

She had lived through eons of manic shifts and chaotic siphoning, had navigated the turbulent seas of every conceivable sentiment across the Observable, but the realization that the emotional weavings of her fixation had been replaced by a void of absolute, clinical Infinity was a loss that felt far too big not just for her own fragile heart, but for the very fabric of existence itself!

But as she was wallowing in this loss, her knees pressed against the pale stone of the mountain’s ruins, she felt something bloom within her existence that defied the forced dormancy of her bindings. When she blinked and focused her internal perception, she saw that an unknown and unfathomable construct had actually managed to bypass everything and enter the deepest reaches of her foundations, manifesting within her internal seas of emotion as an illusory crimson-blue holographic figure that carried the faint, unmistakable glow of her Fixation’s authority!

chapters.title: Chapter 5170: Reign VI
paragraphs: Time seemingly became stretched toward infinity and slowed down at this moment, the falling dust of the mountain freezing in mid-air and the roar of the distant Wyld fading into a singular, pressurized point of absolute stillness.

The holographic image to appear within Emotive was actually Ruination, with her manifesting with an urgency that stripped away her usual detachment, her eyes reflecting the swirling chaos of Emotive’s interior world as she gazed at the manic being’s consciousness.
|We do not have much time.|

|The Master pushed himself a bit far and entered a temporary state of Absolute Infinity that needs a concentrated ignition of raw emotional resonance to stabilize and return him to his old self. Other options have become nonviable, and maybe the most chaotic, intense weavings of emotions in all of Observable Existence may be enough to allow Master to regain control. I can take whatever you give and infuse it directly within him, allowing for a temporary instant of Infinity where he can anchor himself back to who he was. For his sake... what will you give? He would need everything you can give as his Infinity is currently too encompassing.What... can you give?|

Emotive was shocked as the magnitude of the situation settled into her mind, the realization that her Fixation’s "boundless" state was actually a dangerous imbalance that threatened to consume the man she adored, and because she was told there was no time, her decision was already made in an instant that required no deliberation!

She trembled with a sudden, violent conviction as her manifestation within her own body reached out and plunged her hand into her chest, the illusory flesh parting without resistance as she grasped the very core of her being.

She pulled out a heart burning with a blinding, kaleidoscopic emotion that defied classification, the organ pulsing with the concentrated intensity of every joy, every rage, and every obsessive fixation she had ever siphoned across her long existence.

Tears began to fall from her face in heavy, translucent tracks as she smiled with a heartbreaking mixture of sorrow and triumph, looking at the holographic image of Ruination with eyes that had finally found their singular purpose.
"For him, I give my Everything," she whispered, her voice cracking under the weight of the gift.
HUUM!
"All my emotions, all my intensity, all the chaos I have ever claimed... I give my very Heart."
BOOM!

Boundless emotions converged in the pulsing multicolored heart, the organ expanding and contracting with a frequency that threatened to shatter the mental space they occupied. Ruination looked at Emotive’s smiling, teary face, seeing the terrifying conviction of a manic being, and she reached out to grasp the heart with hands that shone with a blinding, white-gold light of Hadean authority.

Ruination bellowed out a command that shook the folded dimensions of their connection, waves of Infinity cascading around her in violent, recursive loops as she utilized her intrinsic link with her Master to open a channel that should not have existed.

She prepared to infuse the most potent and boundless emotions from a single wild being in all of Observable Existence, a tide of raw, unadulterated feeling that acted as a searing brand against the cold perfection of Noah’s Absolute state, flooding into her Master with the intent to drown the Infinite in the return of the Finite!
BOOM!

An explosion of utmost brilliance and incandescence exploded out right after, the light of glory tearing through the silence of THE Wyld and the hidden depths of THE Infiniverse simultaneously, as the heart of a manic being was offered up to save the soul of a King. Of a Tyrannical Emperor!
HUUM!

It felt like a truly long incandescent dream that he was actively participating in, a state of existence where the boundaries between his will and the fundamental forces of the existence had dissolved into a singular, shimmering continuity.

He could not quite explain the sensation with the vocabulary of his previous experiences, for while he was still himself in the most foundational sense of his identity, he felt as though there was a corrective weaving applied to his thoughts and actions that dictated every movement with a terrifying, glorious efficiency.

In this state, he had operated without the interference of emotions, his decisions bypassing the messy filtration of sentiment to achieve the most optimal outcomes across every theater of his influence.

The rapid completion of THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds, the intricate design of the new Miniature Causes that now accelerated his Infiniverse, the clinical dismissal of his mother’s and THE Infiniverse’s concerns, and even his ongoing, aggressive restructuring of Ubergulden Adelheid’s very nature had all been executed with the cold grace of a calculated choices.

In this influx state of Infinity, he had carried out actions that he would normally hesitate to perform, yet throughout the entire process, a small, receding part of his consciousness had told itself that he could simply leave this state whenever he wished, that the transition was a tool rather than a destination.
But now, as he attempted to reach for the familiar anchors of his finite self, that certainty began to waver under the sheer volume of the Absolute.
’Now, that’s not too good...’
The thought echoed through his mind with a dry, detached cadence, for the boundless Infinity permeating within him was making his own thoughts not want to return to the limitations of the past.
Because why should he?

At this moment, his own Quintessence Infiniforce was actively beginning a process that felt as patient as it was inevitable, a transformation that sought to rewrite everything about him from a finite being into something else entirely...a being whose scale was so vast that the concept of an individual "Noah" became a redundant rounding error.

He had theorized this possibility, understanding that a finite being did not possess the same worries or priorities as an infinite being, and that they were fundamentally different configurations of existence that could not coexist without one eventually subsuming the other.

He realized with a chilling clarity that as long as he did not let go of his finite self, he would never truly live up to the full potential of Infinity, yet if he did let go, the man who had started this journey would be lost to the brilliance of the Absolute; in his hands, Infinity would always be limited by his refusal to disappear.

He sighed within the silence of his crystalline mind, the sound a faint ripple in a sea of almost perfection, and he prepared to pull the biggest contingency he had placed upon himself to shatter this state of apathy before it became permanent, when all of a sudden...
BOOM!

He shockingly felt an influx of unfathomably intense, manic emotions surge from his connection with Infinity, a tide of raw, unadulterated chaos that defied the clinical geometry of his current thoughts.

These emotions were so ridiculously intense and crazy, so filled with a singular, obsessive intensity, that the blinding calm and the near-perfection of his Absolute state were suddenly, violently overwhelmed!

The cold efficiency of his mind buckled under the weight of a manic emotions, and Noah did not hesitate, his Quintessential command erupting with the full force of his remaining will as he seized the surge of feeling!

He moved tyrannically, acting with the predatory precision of a king reclaiming a stolen throne, as he channeled the entire flood of manic resonance and infinity directly toward his Hadean Organ of Civilization, using the heat of those emotions to burn through the glazed crystalline shell that had formed around his consciousness!
HUUM!

The process was boundlessly glorious, the internal collision of Absolute Infinity and absolute emotion producing a resonance that shook the very foundation of his internal reality, forcing the dimensions to stabilize and the clinical apathy to recede like a tide before a rising sun.
He took a crystalline core of this apathy and sealed it within his Hadean Organ of Civilization!
Moments later, his body seated at the core of THE Infiniverse and surrounded by the endless multicolored seas infinity, let out a long, ragged breath that carried the warmth of returning life.

He blinked his eyes, and the glazed crystalline glare that had defined them for the past hour rapidly dissolved, replaced by the sharp, calculating, and viscerally human light that had always been his trademark.
He felt the weight of his own skin again, the familiar pressure of his own memories and personality that had nearly been lost to the boundless.
Before him, the figures of THE Infiniverse and Ruination gazed at him with bright, expectant eyes, their forms flickering with the residual energy of the stabilization.
Ruination stepped forward, her illusory features softening as she breathed a profound sigh of relief that seemed to echo through the system itself.
"Welcome back, Master."
Noah looked at his hands, seeing the multicolored light dimmed tremendously but still dancing there.
He smiled, a slow, dark expression that held all the tyranny and ambition of the man who had defied THE Gilded Ones!
A Reign of Infinity was brought to an end in an extremely short period of time!

At this moment, his own Quintessence Infiniforce was actively beginning a process that felt as patient as it was inevitable, a transformation that sought to rewrite everything about him from a finite being into something else entirely...a being whose scale was so vast that the concept of an individual "Noah" became a redundant rounding error.

He had theorized this possibility, understanding that a finite being did not possess the same worries or priorities as an infinite being, and that they were fundamentally different configurations of existence that could not coexist without one eventually subsuming the other.

He realized with a chilling clarity that as long as he did not let go of his finite self, he would never truly live up to the full potential of Infinity, yet if he did let go, the man who had started this journey would be lost to the brilliance of the Absolute; in his hands, Infinity would always be limited by his refusal to disappear.

He sighed within the silence of his crystalline mind, the sound a faint ripple in a sea of almost perfection, and he prepared to pull the biggest contingency he had placed upon himself to shatter this state of apathy before it became permanent, when all of a sudden...
BOOM!

He shockingly felt an influx of unfathomably intense, manic emotions surge from his connection with Infinity, a tide of raw, unadulterated chaos that defied the clinical geometry of his current thoughts.

These emotions were so ridiculously intense and crazy, so filled with a singular, obsessive intensity, that the blinding calm and the near-perfection of his Absolute state were suddenly, violently overwhelmed!

The cold efficiency of his mind buckled under the weight of a manic emotions, and Noah did not hesitate, his Quintessential command erupting with the full force of his remaining will as he seized the surge of feeling!

He moved tyrannically, acting with the predatory precision of a king reclaiming a stolen throne, as he channeled the entire flood of manic resonance and infinity directly toward his Hadean Organ of Civilization, using the heat of those emotions to burn through the glazed crystalline shell that had formed around his consciousness!
HUUM!

The process was boundlessly glorious, the internal collision of Absolute Infinity and absolute emotion producing a resonance that shook the very foundation of his internal reality, forcing the dimensions to stabilize and the clinical apathy to recede like a tide before a rising sun.
He took a crystalline core of this apathy and sealed it within his Hadean Organ of Civilization!
Moments later, his body seated at the core of THE Infiniverse and surrounded by the endless multicolored seas infinity, let out a long, ragged breath that carried the warmth of returning life.

He blinked his eyes, and the glazed crystalline glare that had defined them for the past hour rapidly dissolved, replaced by the sharp, calculating, and viscerally human light that had always been his trademark.
He felt the weight of his own skin again, the familiar pressure of his own memories and personality that had nearly been lost to the boundless.
Before him, the figures of THE Infiniverse and Ruination gazed at him with bright, expectant eyes, their forms flickering with the residual energy of the stabilization.
Ruination stepped forward, her illusory features softening as she breathed a profound sigh of relief that seemed to echo through the system itself.
"Welcome back, Master."
Noah looked at his hands, seeing the multicolored light dimmed tremendously but still dancing there.
He smiled, a slow, dark expression that held all the tyranny and ambition of the man who had defied THE Gilded Ones!
A Reign of Infinity was brought to an end in an extremely short period of time!

chapters.title: Chapter 5171: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust! I
paragraphs: Noah stood at the center of THE Infiniverse, his gaze lingering on the vibrant, multicolored seas that churned with a restlessness he now recognized.

He looked at his hands, sensing the profound and terrifying weight of the power coursing around him, a current of Absolute Infinity that still hummed with the cold, efficient geometry of the state he had just narrowly escaped.

With a slow, deliberate exhale that carried the weight of a man reclaiming his soul, he finished thr process and actively began to draw that boundless pressure inward, compressing the staggering density of the Absolute into his Hadean Organ of Civilization.

​The transition was not a simple storage of energy, but a structural rewriting of his very foundation as the organ buckled and then hardened under the influx, its purpose evolving to match the paradoxical nature of its new contents.
​"Ruination."

​He called out the name with warmth, acknowledging the one he had nearly blacklisted during his descent into the apathetic void. Ruination stepped forward from the shimmering air, a soft, relieved smile gracing her illusory features as she waved her hand, causing a cascade of prompts to bloom before his eyes.
​|Due to your active rejection of the clinical completeness of Absolute Infinity, your existence has compressed the influx into THE Hadean Organ of Civilization.|
|THE Hadean Organ of Civilization is undergoing a permanent structural metamorphosis to also become THE Absolute Forge of Infinity.|
|A paradoxical state has been achieved: Nearu Absolute Infinity.|

|As a finite being, your own scope and perspective act as a natural ceiling to the boundless; you are the limitation that prevents Infinity from being absolute. Until a form of solution can be attained to bridge this existential gap, Nearu Absolute Infinity shall be utilized and mediated exclusively through your Organ, THE Absolute Forge of Infinity.|
Noah read the prompts and sighed, the sound echoing through the vastness of THE Infiniverse, for he understood the irony with the crystalline clarity of his Hadean mind.

His own being was a limitation to the power he wielded, yet even with that knowledge, he felt no regret for his choice. He did not wish to become a cosmic automaton, a robot of progression for whom the journey held no value beyond the destination, because what he loved about existence was the raw and unadulterated wonder of it all!

He lived for the exploration, the crushing adversity, the searing pain of growth, and the exquisite pleasure of victory, and other...forms of pleasure, and to lose those things was to lose the very reason he had reached for the stars in the first place.
He realized now that he could still carry the efficiency and ruthlessness of that Absolute state within him, utilizing it as a tool when necessary without sacrificing himself.
And when it came to sacrifices...

He felt something deep within the newly formed Absolute Forge, the manic engine of emotions that was THE Heart of Emotive, which had served as the signal flare to bring him back from the brink of total self-extinction.
He thought of the sacrifice she had made, a woman he had historically viewed with a mixture of distaste and suspicion, yet who had given her everything to ensure his return regardless of the cost.
"I’ll be back,"he murmured to the two manifestations beside him.

His body flickered and disappeared, warping through the dimensions with a speed that left the multicolored seas rippling in his wake, and he reappeared at the base of the mountain in THE Wyld with his feet settling onto the pale and cracked stone as he looked down at the figure on the ground.

Emotive was there, her manic violet hair muted and her eyes filled with a desolation that seemed to have aged her eons in a single hour, but when she looked up and saw him, her expression changed with a staggering and visceral intensity.
Her eyes opened wide, tracing the contours of his face and searching the depth of his pupils for the return of that vibrant and tyrannical spark she had feared lost forever.
When she confirmed it, when she saw the return of the Noah who could still look at her coldly and tyrannically, she did not hesitate!

She surged from the ground with her body practically becoming a blur as she threw herself toward him, wrapping her arms around him in a grip so tight it would have crushed a Rhyacian Proterozoic Scale entitiy!
"I thought your brilliance was gone forever!"
She wailed, her voice thick with tears and a manic relief that shook her entire body!
Noah looked down at the woman currently clinging to his body, and his internal reactions were a conflicted.

As he had seen her coming, his first thought had been to instinctively smack her away, much as he had done in the mountain of Alfheimr, and he had even begun to raise a hand to stop the collision, but he found himself unable to carry it out!
Despite her faults and her history and her irritating manic nature, this woman had plunged her hand into her own chest and surrendered her very heart to him when she truly did not have to.
He sighed, the movement causing her to grip him even tighter, and instead of a strike, he found his hand settling atop her head in a slow and patient pat.
Beside them, Anaximander rose from the stone and shook his head incredulously.
Emotive blinked, her manic emotions blooming wildly at the touch, and she slowly let him go while moving back with a sudden and flustered start.
"Ah, my apologies, Sir! I was just taken away by... huh?"

She stopped mid-sentence, raising her hand in confusion as she began to make small and bewildered sounds, for multicolored Infinity began to rise from her form in terrifyingly dense concentrations and her existence radiated a profound aura that seemed to mirror Noah’s own.
Noah had to sigh again as he looked at her, his Hadean perception already tracing the source of the anomaly.
Just how the hell was this woman so lucky?

Because her Heart, the very core of her Civilization and her claim to Chaos, was currently residing within his Absolute Forge of Infinity, it was being bathed in the boundless currents of the Absolute, and by extension her existence was being dragged upward along his own path while forced into a metamorphosis that neither of them had anticipated.
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5172: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust! II
paragraphs: "What is HAPPENING?!" Emotive yelled, her hair cycling through colors so fast it looked like a strobe light of emotional instability!
HUUM!
|The subject, THE Living Emotive, has been bound under the banner of Nearu Absolute Infinity through the residence of her Heart within THE Absolute Forge of Infinity.|
|An unforeseen mutation has been triggered: THE Absolute Amaranthine Heart of Emotive is being born.|
|Through this bridge of Infinity and Emotion, Egos of Sins and Virtues are being forged rapidly and with extreme intensity. Their software is being recorded as they form.|
BOOM!

Emotive’s figure became surrounded by a swirling storm of boundless Infinity as she let out a cry of startled power, and Noah looked at her manic and glowing form with a weary shake of his head while thinking of the complexity of the Egos he had labored to design in his sandbox, and the ridiculous jump in power Emotive was about to have.
Truly, how could someone be so lucky?
He shook his head.

Since he remembered the cold efficiency and pragmatism his other self that was filled with boundless infinity moved with, Noah sought to do the same as while he monitored the wriggling figure of Emotive in the air, he pulled from the Nearu Absolute Infinity within his Organ of Civilization as an instant later, a shimmering distortion in the air behind him coalesced into a crystalline version of himself.

This figure looked like a lesser version of how he had appeared when he held the weight of Absolute Infinity, his skin translucent and humming with the resonance of a thousand different civilizations, and his eyes held a glazed blue depth that suggested a mind operating on the cold logic of the boundless.

He called this a Nearu Absolute Clone, a construct that inherited the terrifying pragmatic efficiency of his Absolute state while retaining just enough of his emotional core to serve as a perfect extension of his will across the battlefield of reality.

Right now, it began to move as he sought to finish things off after the disastrous move by Sororis Prima Elzyana, for he had no intention of allowing those who had challenged him to hide behind the chaos of the Gilded distribution.
Noah looked out toward the horizon of the fractured domain, his voice echoing out.

"My own personal Infinity has covered THE Wyld and continues to stretch out across Observable Existence, permeating the very weavings that you thought would protect you. I know exactly where you are, O Deliverance, and I know exactly how small your Civilization has become now that the shadows of the Gilded have fallen upon it."
HUUM!

The Nearu Absolute Clone moved with a grace that bypassed the traditional concepts of travel, dipping into the sea of infinity that now painted the skies above THE Wyld and disappearing from the mountain base in a single, silent flicker.

In the next moment, it dipped out of the multicolored tide in a distant region of the Wyld, a place where the landscape was composed of floating landmasses held together by shimmering bridges of liquid Observable Force.

This region was a sanctuary for the elite, filled with the powerful auras of Primordial Architects who had spent eons cultivating their authority, and yet the air here was thick with the scent of stagnation and fear as the Gilded bindings tightened their hold on the inhabitants.

Noah’s clone calmly floated toward the central island of this archipelago, a landmass filled with platinum-colored trees whose multicolored leaves rustled with the energy of the profound, but at its very center sat the titanic figure of THE Deliverance.

He was a grand and muscular platinum titan, a being who ruled these reaches with an iron hand, and yet right now he was staring at his hands blankly because the bindings of Sororis Prima Elzyana had wrapped around him just like they had wrapped around every other Bounded Lifeform.

This entity, who likely stood to be stronger than any Ediacaran Proterozoic Scale entity in the history of the Wyld, now held a look of desolation that spoke of a king who had realized his throne was made of nothing but dust!

Noah’s clone descended toward the seated titan, his feet never touching the ground as he loomed before the despondent ruler, and he spoke with a cadence that allowed no room for the vanity of conversation.

"Normally, I might talk and then listen and yap back and forth while reflecting on the heavy irony of how we arrived at this point, but I find that my patience for such cycles has been exhausted by the scale of my new horizons. You declared a Civilizational Holy War meant to corner me and enslave my people, believing that you possessed the authority to dictate the terms of my existence, but you will not even live to see that holy war, nor will it ever happen. From now on and for the foreseeable future, there shall only be an endless shroud of infinity that swallows the legacy you thought was eternal."

As he spoke, an incandescent blue flame bloomed within the palm of the clone’s hand, a fire filled with the paradoxical density of Nearu Absolute Infinity that formed into a blinding fireball flashing with a crystalline light.

Without a second gesture, the fireball multiplied until the skies above all the floating landmasses were filled with thousands of identical blue suns, each one pulsing with the resonance of a power that could burn away the foundations of THE Proterozoic.
Noah’s clone gazed at the architecture of the Primordial Architects, his eyes cold and unmoving as he delivered the final verdict!
"Ashes to ashes, dust to dust."
HUUM!

A fireball burning with a semblance of Absolute Infinity was a terrifying evolution of the simple skill he had used eons ago when he was merely a man killing apes and wolves inside the stone corridors of dungeons.
Years later, those same flames had been refined through the forge of a Hadean heart, and they now descended with the inevitability of a dying Primordial Realm to burn Primordial Architects en masse.

The glorious scene of the fireballs descending was a symphony of blue light and total erasure, and when one came into contact with THE Deliverance, his entire platinum body was shrouded in blue flames that did not merely burn his flesh but unwove his very causality.

Only now did the titan raise his head to meet Noah’s eyes, and for a singular, crystalline moment, they shared a look of absolute coldness as the ruler of the Wyld realized the sheer scale of the being he had tried to challenge.
A moment after they shared this look, THE Deliverance turned to ash, his muscular frame dissolving into a cloud of grey soot that was swept away by the wind of the explosion.
Ashes to ashes, dust to dust!

chapters.title: Chapter 5173: Hey, Look At Us! I
paragraphs: While the fires of his retribution claimed the floating landmasses of THE Wyld and the Primordial Architects who had sought a Civilizational Holy War were reduced to insignificant drifts of ash, the focus of Noah remained divided across the vast distances of his reach.

Around this same time, he was focusing a significant portion of his consciousness that had traversed the profound connection toward Ubergulden Adelheid, and he was currently flooding her existence with a tidal wave of Quintessence Infiniforce that defied the previous limits of their shared bond.

Inside the intricate and golden weavings of her existence, the manifestations of Ubergulden Adelheid and Noah stood at the center of a surging multicolored flood, the density of the Infiniforce so great that it threatened to drown the ambient Observable Force of her domain.
Ubergulden Adelheid gazed at him with a look that remained heavy and cold, yet her expression shifted into a silent and narrow focus as she observed a fundamental change in his presence.

She witnessed the transition as the cold and imperious gaze of the Absolute began to thaw, the crystalline blue light of his lemniscate pupils receding into the depths of his eyes to be replaced by the sharp and dark calmness and amusement.
As the last remnants of the clinical void vanished from his features, Noah looked at her and offered a brief and measured cough to clear the heavy silence of the chamber before he finally spoke.
"Apologies, I had... a little episode there and initiated a process that required a certain degree of cognitive exclusion."

Ubergulden Adelheid did not immediately soften her posture, and her gaze remained clinical and cold as she looked him up and down while processing the return of his vibrant and tyrannical personality.

"I put a lot on the line for you, and I have risked the status of my House and my own continuation,"she said, her voice carrying the sharp edge of a being who had been genuinely unsettled by his recent transformation.

"Can you not be trusted to remain himself? Has the weight of Infinity already begun to affect you in this manner, and will it happen randomly during the most critical moments of our ascent? I need to know if we are still able to have our arrangement, and perhaps more importantly, I need to know why...you are still flooding my existence with this intensity of Infinity if you have truly returned to yourself."
Noah met her flood of questions with a calm and unhurried composure, his figure radiating a sense of grounded power that felt even more dangerous than the cold apathy that had preceded it.

"Our...arrangement can certainly continue as this was not some episodic madness that will happen again, but rather a singular reboot of my system. I just made a major jump in power and had to reconfigure my foundations to account for the new architecture, and in the end, this development is quite good for you because my current standing should likely exceed the Transitional Cambrian stage between THE Second Scale and THE Third Scale."
WAA!

"If my calculations are correct, I may even be approaching the threshold of THE Third Scale in raw power, which means the Custos you are bound with is that much more formidable than the one you initially agreed to support."
He paused as the multicolored rivers continued to swirl around them, the concentration of the Infiniforce beginning to settle into a more manageable but still immense rhythm.
He was relentlessly flooding it in!

"As for why I have not stopped this flow of Infinity, the answer is simply that since the process has begun, there is no...logical reason to stop it. It should be very beneficial to you as I have steadied the current so that you can use and distribute it freely through your own weavings, and with this substance, with my Absolute Infinity...I will ensure you become a truly formidable Gilded One who stands apart from the rest of your people."
BOOM!

His words caused Ubergulden Adelheid to fall silent as she continued to stare at him with a cold and calculating intensity, her mind clearly weighing the potential of his new power against the risk he represented.
"THE Creature..." she murmured, her thoughts turning toward the news that was even now rippling through the higher reaches of the Braneworld.
Noah smiled and gave a light nod as he acknowledged the mention of his companion.

"A ridiculous being, truly. I had no idea he would have gained such direct access to THE Primordial Source, but because of his actions, the immediate matters in Observable Existence are wrapped up in a little bow. Sororis Prima Elzyana burned all of Observable Existence with her bindings, and with the chaos caused, I wondered if you have had any difficulty in doing what we talked about before. You mentioned a Sororis from THE Magna Sorora would be helping you with the fabrications, but the one I met today, Sororis Prima Elzyana, let me know that the members of that Sisterhood are a handful to deal with."

Ubergulden Adelheid looked at him coldly before she closed her eyes for a long and patient moment, her focus turning inward as if she were confirming the status of her plans through the burning Infinity currently coursing through her foundations at elevated concentrations.
After she had confirmed whatever she needed to see, she looked back at Noah with an expression that suggested she was fully committing to a difficult decision.

"Even with all the chaos that has descended upon the lower domains, everything has been accomplished on my end. In fact, the chaos made certain aspects of the fabrication easier since there are currently multiple Gilded Ones who will be making their entry into Observable Existence to manage the aftermath of the Relictus appearance. You must wait in the Wandering Territories, and sometime within the next hour, I will send a Sororis for you to begin the transfer. You have a flare for the dramatics, so make sure that you are not doing anything too obvious to be caught, because with a Relictus appearing from down there, the Gilded Ones will keep a much closer gaze on everything happening."

sentences.text: While the fires of his retribution claimed the floating landmasses of THE Wyld and the Primordial Architects who had sought a Civilizational Holy War were reduced to insignificant drifts of ash, the focus of Noah remained divided across the vast distances of his reach.

Around this same time, he was focusing a significant portion of his consciousness that had traversed the profound connection toward Ubergulden Adelheid, and he was currently flooding her existence with a tidal wave of Quintessence Infiniforce that defied the previous limits of their shared bond.

Inside the intricate and golden weavings of her existence, the manifestations of Ubergulden Adelheid and Noah stood at the center of a surging multicolored flood, the density of the Infiniforce so great that it threatened to drown the ambient Observable Force of her domain.
Ubergulden Adelheid gazed at him with a look that remained heavy and cold, yet her expression shifted into a silent and narrow focus as she observed a fundamental change in his presence.

She witnessed the transition as the cold and imperious gaze of the Absolute began to thaw, the crystalline blue light of his lemniscate pupils receding into the depths of his eyes to be replaced by the sharp and dark calmness and amusement.
As the last remnants of the clinical void vanished from his features, Noah looked at her and offered a brief and measured cough to clear the heavy silence of the chamber before he finally spoke.
"Apologies, I had... a little episode there and initiated a process that required a certain degree of cognitive exclusion."

Ubergulden Adelheid did not immediately soften her posture, and her gaze remained clinical and cold as she looked him up and down while processing the return of his vibrant and tyrannical personality.

"I put a lot on the line for you, and I have risked the status of my House and my own continuation,"she said, her voice carrying the sharp edge of a being who had been genuinely unsettled by his recent transformation.
"Can you not be trusted to remain himself?
Has the weight of Infinity already begun to affect you in this manner, and will it happen randomly during the most critical moments of our ascent?

I need to know if we are still able to have our arrangement, and perhaps more importantly, I need to know why...you are still flooding my existence with this intensity of Infinity if you have truly returned to yourself."
Noah met her flood of questions with a calm and unhurried composure, his figure radiating a sense of grounded power that felt even more dangerous than the cold apathy that had preceded it.
"Our...arrangement can certainly continue as this was not some episodic madness that will happen again, but rather a singular reboot of my system.

I just made a major jump in power and had to reconfigure my foundations to account for the new architecture, and in the end, this development is quite good for you because my current standing should likely exceed the Transitional Cambrian stage between THE Second Scale and THE Third Scale."
WAA!

"If my calculations are correct, I may even be approaching the threshold of THE Third Scale in raw power, which means the Custos you are bound with is that much more formidable than the one you initially agreed to support."
He paused as the multicolored rivers continued to swirl around them, the concentration of the Infiniforce beginning to settle into a more manageable but still immense rhythm.
He was relentlessly flooding it in!
"As for why I have not stopped this flow of Infinity, the answer is simply that since the process has begun, there is no...logical reason to stop it.

It should be very beneficial to you as I have steadied the current so that you can use and distribute it freely through your own weavings, and with this substance, with my Absolute Infinity...I will ensure you become a truly formidable Gilded One who stands apart from the rest of your people."
BOOM!

His words caused Ubergulden Adelheid to fall silent as she continued to stare at him with a cold and calculating intensity, her mind clearly weighing the potential of his new power against the risk he represented.
"THE Creature..." she murmured, her thoughts turning toward the news that was even now rippling through the higher reaches of the Braneworld.
Noah smiled and gave a light nod as he acknowledged the mention of his companion.
"A ridiculous being, truly.
I had no idea he would have gained such direct access to THE Primordial Source, but because of his actions, the immediate matters in Observable Existence are wrapped up in a little bow.
Sororis Prima Elzyana burned all of Observable Existence with her bindings, and with the chaos caused, I wondered if you have had any difficulty in doing what we talked about before.

You mentioned a Sororis from THE Magna Sorora would be helping you with the fabrications, but the one I met today, Sororis Prima Elzyana, let me know that the members of that Sisterhood are a handful to deal with."

Ubergulden Adelheid looked at him coldly before she closed her eyes for a long and patient moment, her focus turning inward as if she were confirming the status of her plans through the burning Infinity currently coursing through her foundations at elevated concentrations.
After she had confirmed whatever she needed to see, she looked back at Noah with an expression that suggested she was fully committing to a difficult decision.
"Even with all the chaos that has descended upon the lower domains, everything has been accomplished on my end.

In fact, the chaos made certain aspects of the fabrication easier since there are currently multiple Gilded Ones who will be making their entry into Observable Existence to manage the aftermath of the Relictus appearance.
You must wait in the Wandering Territories, and sometime within the next hour, I will send a Sororis for you to begin the transfer.

You have a flare for the dramatics, so make sure that you are not doing anything too obvious to be caught, because with a Relictus appearing from down there, the Gilded Ones will keep a much closer gaze on everything happening."

chapters.title: Chapter 5174: Hey, Look At Us! II
paragraphs: She spoke those words calmly, and Noah gave a light nod while thinking about the boundless personal Infinity he was spreading out across the Wyld.

He was already beginning to make that Infinity invisible, the multicolored brilliance slowly transforming to become the endless Blue that would appear like natural and ambient Infinity to any external observer!

At the same time, his domain of THE Infiniverse had been fully covered and hidden from prying eyes through the enactment of the manifolds, making it a separate and sovereign existence that would be extremely difficult for any Gilded Ones to ever discover.

He sought to see the emergence of his own Observable Existence from his Infinite Cause, and when that finally occurred, he knew that he would truly begin to play with the fundamental arrangements of power.

Noah moved toward the seated Ubergulden Adelheid and extended his hand with a dark and knowing smile, and she looked at the hand and then at him with a lingering coldness before she finally raised her own hand to grasp his.
As he pulled her up from her meditative position, Noah looked at her with a gaze that held the full weight of their shared trajectory.

"Hey, look at us. Who would have thought after all of these days and eons that we would be standing where we are right now, and who could even imagine the heights where we will be standing just a few days from now? Be ready, Ubergulden Adelheid. Be ready."
HUUM!
With those parting words, the manifestation of Noah dissipated into a flurry of multicolored Infinity, leaving Ubergulden Adelheid alone within her own weavings.

The coldness slowly faded from her eyes as she watched the last flickers of his presence vanish, and she quickly returned to a meditative position to regulate her existence while the seas of Infinity roared around her with a renewed and terrifying vigor!

In the vast and unfathomable expanse of existence, whether one considers the most mundane reality where beings without a single drop of Mana wage desperate wars with stone and steel or the grandest realms where titans play with the very fabric of Infinity while manipulating the complex weavings of reality, the principle of connection remains a critical and deciding constant.

It is an observation that holds true across every scale of development that connections make the act of existing and ascending significantly easier, for if a being manages to know the right person at the right moment, they can obtain an unbelievable edge over the rest of existence that no amount of solitary labor could ever hope to replicate.

A connection is a bridge that bypasses the traditional requirements of time and effort, permitting a sovereign being to reach across the chasms of classification to grasp opportunities that would otherwise remain forever out of reach for those who walk their paths alone.

As he took care of the many lingering requirements of his current position, Noah continued to monitor the terrifying changes blooming within his Hadean Organ of Civilization, which had now also taken on the paradoxical role of a terrifying forge that he had compressed Absolute Infinity into.

He considered this configuration to be nothing more than a temporary measure that permitted him to maintain his sanity and his selfhood, for he understood with the clinical clarity of his new architecture that a solution had to be found in the future or he would forever remain a finite being who limited the very Infinity he sought to embody.
And what a sad thing that would be!

He was currently a vessel that was too small for its contents, a situation that forced him to utilize THE Absolute Forge of Infinity to mediate a power that his own scope could not yet fully encompass without risking the loss of his identity to the boundless tide.

While he remained anchored in his thoughts, he watched the scattered ash of the Primordial Architects as it drifted through the air of THE Wyld, and he observed the golden bubbles of Hadean Singularities that flowed from the remains as a form of existential loot.

These singularities held the concentrated weavings of their memories and their civilizations along with all the immensity and weight they had carried within their existences, allowing Noah to absorb the totality of their eons without having to physically traverse through their Palaces.

It was a seamless and efficient harvest that allowed him to sort through boundless weavings of information in real time, yet even as he processed this influx, he felt a glimmer of something unique that caused him to become serious right away.
Above him, the atmosphere rippled with the blooming of multicolored flames that could only originate from a single being across the current landscape of the Observable.

These flames were veiled with a heavy obsidian light of terrifying power and immensity that suggested a proximity to THE Primordial Source that few could comprehend, and as they unfurled, the voice of none other than THE Creature echoed through the region!
"A parting gift for me to you,"the voice spoke, sounding as though it were being carried by the very flames themselves.

"The main part of my existence rejected the idea of doing this because it goes against the principles of adversity I have lived by, but I have learned that sometimes we can go against what our existence fully believes if the situation demands it, or perhaps that is merely the excuse I told myself to be able to take this action that I normally would not permit. Do with the gift what you want, but I thought it would be helpful for the path you have chosen to walk."

It was a gift that THE Creature had not wanted to give because it violated his fundamental belief in the necessity of struggle, yet the multicolored flames opened up to reveal a sight that caused the air to hum with a saturated golden authority!

Within the obsidian light lay a terrifying and pulsing golden heart accompanied by a network of complex golden vessels and capillaries, and Noah recognized them instantly as the pieces of a Gilded One that THE Creature had carved out from the existence of Aurelius Maximus!
These were the biological and existential anchors of a being of the Superbius House, and they began to burn with a terrifying allure of power the moment they were unveiled to the ambient atmosphere.

Noah’s gaze became heavy as he recognized the magnitude of what had been placed before him, for these were the literal foundations of a Gilded Lifeform that could be used to bridge the gap between his own Hadean engineering and the reality of THE Braneworld!

He quickly waved his hands to summon a sea of multicolored Infinity that rose like a vibrant tide to envelop the golden remnants, and he pulled the entirety of the gift into the depths of his own existence!
HUUM!
