chapters.title: Chapter 5175: Ego I
paragraphs: Existence is a series of punctuations, a collection of moments where the steady rhythm of the mundane is interrupted by the violent imposition of the extraordinary, yet among the many shifts that bloomed across the vastness of the Observable and Unobservable, there remained a specific category of upheaval that commanded the attention of even the most ancient and knowledgeable beings.

There are debates every now and then between those who have witnessed the turn of eons, but most tend to agree that the point of greatest change occured when a Relictus emerged from a place they had never emerged from before, for that was the singular spark that set the ball of Existence rolling towards weavings that no one could have anticipated, leading to an era of upheaval and glorious immensity that defied every established scale of progress!

The Nearu Absolute Clone materialized in a region of THE Wyld defined by an endless expanse of dazzling snow, the crystalline flakes falling in a silent and heavy rhythm that sought to bury the evidence of the violence beneath a layer of pristine white.

Naldine Manthon sat upon the obscenely fat and golden shoulders of the greed-personified Midas, her radiant white hair flowing behind her like a river of ivory and gold while her singularity-dotted eyes tracked the descent of the flakes with a heavy and detached melancholy that suggested she had already witnessed enough upheaval for a single existence.

Midas remained stationary as a mountain of golden muscle and excess, his blue-gold wings folded tightly against his frame while the golden rings of Greed orbited his limbs in a slow and patient rotation that kept the accumulating snow from settling upon his skin.

Around them, the corpses of four Primordial Architects were scattered across the frozen ground, their once-grand existences reduced to cold and silent monuments that were rapidly being claimed by the accumulation of the snow, their authority extinguished in the same clinical manner that the Gilded had intended for every Bounded Lifeform.

Naldine absent-mindedly released her hands from Midas’s shoulders to have the snow land on her palm, watching as the heat of her Hadean physiology caused the crystalline structure to dissolve into a tiny drop of moisture while the ambient silence of the region pressed against her foundations.

Noah’s Nearu Absolute Clone appeared before them with the silent grace of a ghost, his figure radiating a soft and multicolored brilliance that cast long shadows across the white terrain, and Naldine looked up at him with an expression that held a profound sense of sorrow as she spoke.

"You finally came looking for me?" she asked."I would ask you what happened out there, but I can assume from the way the everything has been overwritten that the conclusion was...as grand as your aspirations."

Noah offered an assuring smile as he floated over toward her, his presence bringing a sudden and comforting warmth to the frozen air that seemed to push back the desolate chill of the region, and he leaned forward to press a gentle kiss against her forehead.

He could sense that she was partially bounded by the clinical and suffocating actions of Sororis Prima Elzyana, her internal architecture struggling against the bindings and the forced dormancy of her Civilization.
"Let’s get those bindings fully off of you first,"he said softly, his authority rising to meet the golden pressure within her skin.
HUUM!

He waved his hand to summon a sea of multicolored Infinity that rose from the snowy ground like a vibrant and rising tide, wrapping Naldine and Midas in a protective and irresistible embrace before taking them away toward the hidden sanctuary of his own making where the rules of the Gilded held no sway!
He took them towards THE Infiniverse!

In a different area on that vast mountain in THE Wyld where the ruins of the temple remained as silent witnesses to the afternoon’s carnage, Noah, Emotive, and Anaximander remained beneath a sky that was now fully claimed by the invisible brilliance of infinity- one that would seem like any of the common seas of endless potential permeating in potent regions of Observable Existence!

Noah observed the image of THE Living Emotive as she floated in the air while boundless Infinity surged around her existence, her figure dancing manically within the shifting currents of a transformation that had been forced upon her by the sheer weight of her own sacrifice.

While all of this occurred, and while the atmosphere continued to hum with the resonance of his Nearu Absolute state, he walked over toward Anaximander, who rose up from the pale stone and appeared to be exactly the same as always even though he should have been bound by the clinical and suffocating bindings that Sororis Prima Elzyana had distributed across every reach of the Observable.
Noah looked at the scholarly figure for a long and patient moment, his eyes reflecting the sharp brilliance of a being who had just returned from the precipice of the Absolute.
"How are you holding up, big guy?"
Anaximander looked up toward the empty skies where THE Creature had departed, his expression carrying a mixture of scholarly detachment and a deep, private sorrow that he did not attempt to mask.

"I considered myself the oldest friend of THE Creature, or perhaps I should say that I considered him my oldest friend, for we have walked the paths of the unknown for longer than most civilizations have existed. He has left right now for what may be the longest or perhaps the last time, and while I talked with him time and time again on what the future would look like after he had finally accomplished what he wanted, he was always staunch on his ideals regarding the necessity of standing against those whom one cannot go against."
HUUM!

"He is gone now, facing adversity and challenges that no existence should ever have to face alone, and yet this was the path he chose with his own hands, and so now...I will choose my own path to follow."

chapters.title: Chapter 5176: Ego II
paragraphs: Anaximander’s eyes sparkled with a sudden and renewed light as he turned his gaze back toward Noah, his tall frame straightening with the conviction of a new purpose.

"I loved my life as an explorer, as Anaximander, and I will live this life to its fullest potential now that the boundaries are being shattered. I will see what else lies in our Observable Existence and in the Braneworld Observable Existence. I...will see it all, Osmont, I will see it all!"
WAA!
Noah gave him a long and appreciative look while nodding his head in a gesture of genuine respect.
"Good luck, and be safe."
Anaximander nodded with a soft smile, and in the next moment, he took a single step and disappeared from the ruined mountain!
Where he went, even Noah could not say for certain with his current perception, but he reflected on the nature of the gifts THE Creature had distributed before his departure.

Compared to the pulsing golden heart and the Gilded vessels that had been given to him, the gift bestowed upon Anaximander must have been something grand enough to ensure that Noah would not have to worry about the safety of the explorer, for THE Creature was not a being who would leave his oldest companion without the means to survive the coming complexities.

Noah thought about his own gifts that his Nearu Absolute Clone had already taken into the sovereign domain of THE Infiniverse, and he knew that he would soon open them up to see exactly what wonders would bloom within his architecture.
But for now, his focus had to remain on the woman who had given her everything in order to bring him back from the edge of a cold and perfect apathetic state.

He turned his gaze back to the manic woman floating in the air and screaming as the Infinity continued to surge around her, and he felt as though something incredible was happening inside of his Hadean Organ of Civilization. Within THE Absolute Forge of Infinity, a terrifying product had bloomed as the result of emotions being ridiculously amplified and infinitely elevated by the presence of the Absolute.
He closed his eyes to see exactly what wonder had bloomed from the sacrifice of a manic heart.

Noah appeared inside his Hadean Organ of Civilization, moving through the intricate layers of his own existence until he stood within the center of THE Absolute Forge of Infinity, a place that held within its architecture the terrible weight of THE Hadean Desmoterion where Ozymandias presided over prisoners like THE worthless and shitty Living Elemental.

The Forge itself was a new and pristine component that looked unfathomably vast and immaculate, an internal landscape of polished blue and gold lattices that stretched into a horizon composed of nothing but boundless Infinity, and the air within this space hummed with the resonance of a reality that was actively being rewritten.

At the very center of this immaculate workshop stood THE Absolute Amaranthine Heart of Emotive, a pulsing and radiant gem of impossible complexity that glowed with a deep and manic violet light while casting long shadows of emotional authority across the crystalline floor.

Surrounding the heart were fourteen massive illusory manifestations of Noah himself, each one representing a different potential iteration of his existence that had been forged through the collision of his Nearu Absolute Infinity and the manic intensity of Emotive’s sacrifice.

These versions of him stood in silent and translucent rows, representing the Infinitely Amplified and Engineered Egos that were the product of a process that no other being in the history of the Observable could have initiated with such precision.

Each figure held a different posture and carried a different atmospheric weight, ranging from the suffocating pressure of absolute tyranny to the quiet and terrifying stillness of total surrender, their forms flickering with the multicolored light of the Absolute Forge.

The crimson-blue illusory figure of Ruination appeared in this space with a sudden flicker of digital light, and she stepped forward to bow deeply toward her Master with a smile that carried both pride and satisfaction.

She began to float around the space while gesturing toward the fourteen manifestations, her hands tracing lines of data in the air as she prepared to explain the magnitude of what had been created within the forge.
|Master, the product of your Existential Engineering has reached a state of stabilization within THE Absolute Forge of Infinity, resulting in the birth ofTHE Absolute Egos of Infinity.|

|These Egos are blank slates of sovereign authority that your existence can select to fully embody, allowing your external self to project the totality of a single amplified concept while utilizing the full depth of your Infinity as its engine.|

|The logic of the Gilded Ones was sound in this regard, for they understood that mixing multiple amplified Egos would result in a diluted and impure manifestation where the individual strengths of each concept would interfere with one another, leading to a loss of the grandest individual features.|

|Therefore, THE Absolute Egos of Infinity were born to ensure that you can transition between states of perfect and unadulterated authority, each interacting with Infinity in a unique manner to amplify specific aspects of your capability and your Infinite Radiation.|

Noah’s eyes shone with a sharp and focused intensity as he turned to look at THE Absolute Superbius Ego of Infinity, observing the illusory form that stood with its chin lifted and its eyes reflecting a pride so absolute that it seemed to bend the light around it.

The figure was draped in robes of molten gold and obsidian that flowed like liquid fire, and the aura it radiated was one of undeniable sovereignty that demanded the submission of every weaving in its presence, its figure pulsing with the heartbeat of a king who had never known a peer!
|THE Absolute Superbius Ego of Infinity allows your existence to fully embody the extreme of Pride, and it grants the following capabilities:|

|THE Sovereign Overwrite: Your authority gains the capacity to treat the weavings of others as mere suggestions, permitting you to overwrite their Civilizations and Laws with your own preferred arrangements through the sheer weight of your existence.|

sentences.text: Anaximander’s eyes sparkled with a sudden and renewed light as he turned his gaze back toward Noah, his tall frame straightening with the conviction of a new purpose.
"I loved my life as an explorer, as Anaximander, and I will live this life to its fullest potential now that the boundaries are being shattered.
I will see what else lies in our Observable Existence and in the Braneworld Observable Existence.
I...will see it all, Osmont, I will see it all!"
WAA!
Noah gave him a long and appreciative look while nodding his head in a gesture of genuine respect.
"Good luck, and be safe."
Anaximander nodded with a soft smile, and in the next moment, he took a single step and disappeared from the ruined mountain!
Where he went, even Noah could not say for certain with his current perception, but he reflected on the nature of the gifts THE Creature had distributed before his departure.

Compared to the pulsing golden heart and the Gilded vessels that had been given to him, the gift bestowed upon Anaximander must have been something grand enough to ensure that Noah would not have to worry about the safety of the explorer, for THE Creature was not a being who would leave his oldest companion without the means to survive the coming complexities.

Noah thought about his own gifts that his Nearu Absolute Clone had already taken into the sovereign domain of THE Infiniverse, and he knew that he would soon open them up to see exactly what wonders would bloom within his architecture.
But for now, his focus had to remain on the woman who had given her everything in order to bring him back from the edge of a cold and perfect apathetic state.

He turned his gaze back to the manic woman floating in the air and screaming as the Infinity continued to surge around her, and he felt as though something incredible was happening inside of his Hadean Organ of Civilization.
Within THE Absolute Forge of Infinity, a terrifying product had bloomed as the result of emotions being ridiculously amplified and infinitely elevated by the presence of the Absolute.
He closed his eyes to see exactly what wonder had bloomed from the sacrifice of a manic heart.

Noah appeared inside his Hadean Organ of Civilization, moving through the intricate layers of his own existence until he stood within the center of THE Absolute Forge of Infinity, a place that held within its architecture the terrible weight of THE Hadean Desmoterion where Ozymandias presided over prisoners like THE worthless and shitty Living Elemental.

The Forge itself was a new and pristine component that looked unfathomably vast and immaculate, an internal landscape of polished blue and gold lattices that stretched into a horizon composed of nothing but boundless Infinity, and the air within this space hummed with the resonance of a reality that was actively being rewritten.

At the very center of this immaculate workshop stood THE Absolute Amaranthine Heart of Emotive, a pulsing and radiant gem of impossible complexity that glowed with a deep and manic violet light while casting long shadows of emotional authority across the crystalline floor.

Surrounding the heart were fourteen massive illusory manifestations of Noah himself, each one representing a different potential iteration of his existence that had been forged through the collision of his Nearu Absolute Infinity and the manic intensity of Emotive’s sacrifice.

These versions of him stood in silent and translucent rows, representing the Infinitely Amplified and Engineered Egos that were the product of a process that no other being in the history of the Observable could have initiated with such precision.

Each figure held a different posture and carried a different atmospheric weight, ranging from the suffocating pressure of absolute tyranny to the quiet and terrifying stillness of total surrender, their forms flickering with the multicolored light of the Absolute Forge.

The crimson-blue illusory figure of Ruination appeared in this space with a sudden flicker of digital light, and she stepped forward to bow deeply toward her Master with a smile that carried both pride and satisfaction.

She began to float around the space while gesturing toward the fourteen manifestations, her hands tracing lines of data in the air as she prepared to explain the magnitude of what had been created within the forge.
|Master, the product of your Existential Engineering has reached a state of stabilization within THE Absolute Forge of Infinity, resulting in the birth ofTHE Absolute Egos of Infinity.|

|These Egos are blank slates of sovereign authority that your existence can select to fully embody, allowing your external self to project the totality of a single amplified concept while utilizing the full depth of your Infinity as its engine.|

|The logic of the Gilded Ones was sound in this regard, for they understood that mixing multiple amplified Egos would result in a diluted and impure manifestation where the individual strengths of each concept would interfere with one another, leading to a loss of the grandest individual features.|

|Therefore, THE Absolute Egos of Infinity were born to ensure that you can transition between states of perfect and unadulterated authority, each interacting with Infinity in a unique manner to amplify specific aspects of your capability and your Infinite Radiation.|

The figure was draped in robes of molten gold and obsidian that flowed like liquid fire, and the aura it radiated was one of undeniable sovereignty that demanded the submission of every weaving in its presence, its figure pulsing with the heartbeat of a king who had never known a peer!

|THE Sovereign Overwrite: Your authority gains the capacity to treat the weavings of others as mere suggestions, permitting you to overwrite their Civilizations and Laws with your own preferred arrangements through the sheer weight of your existence.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5177: Ego III
paragraphs: The capabilities of THE Absolute Superbius Ego of Infinity continued to unfold before him!

|THE Infallible Aegis of Pride:Damage directed at your figure is reduced by ninety-nine percent if the source of the attack is deemed ’lesser’ by your Ego, for the concept of Pride refuses to acknowledge the validity of a strike from an inferior being, rendering their efforts into nothing but wasted motion.|

|THE Monarch’s Pulse of Infinity:Your Infinite Light is amplified by the weight of your Superbius, causing the regression of targets to occur ten times more potent and faster while simultaneously inflicting a state of existential despair that prevents the activation of any defensive contingencies.|

|THE Absolute Supremacy Radiation of Infinity: Your passive Existential Radiation has been refined through the forge to broadcast your supremacy as an immutable fact of existence, ensuring that any being within range involuntarily perceives their own foundations as fundamentally lesser while their Egos find themselves unable to maintain their engineered amplifications in your presence. As the radiation permeates the local substrate, the confidence of your enemies collapses and their Civilizations and skills operate at a drastically reduced efficiency because the beings wielding them can no longer believe fully in their own capacity while you occupy the same coordinate, and even other weak Gilded Ones of the Superbius classifications may feel their very Existence shrink as your existence dictates the terms of the encounter through the sheer weight of your singular sovereignty.|
Oh!
The capabilities were grand as Noah couldn’t help but smack his lips!
Okay.
Okay!

Noah then turned his gaze towardTHE Absolute Humilitas Ego of Infinity, which stood in stark contrast to the first, appearing as a figure of quiet and terrifying simplicity with its hands folded and its head bowed slightly in a gesture of total release.

This manifestation radiated a stillness so profound that it felt like a void in the atmosphere, a state of existence that had discarded every layer of self until only the core of his Infinity remained as a silent and watchful observer.
|THE Absolute Humilitas Ego of Infinityis the inverse of Pride, and it grants the following capabilities:|

|THE Void of Surrender: Your existence becomes imperceptible to the intent and perception of others, for a being with no Pride provides no surface for enmity or detection to find purchase upon, allowing you to move through existence as a phantom of the Absolute. It is estimated that those on Vakochev’s Third Scale and below may entirely not be able to perceive you.|

|THE Reflective Mirror of the Humble:Attacks directed at you are not resisted but are instead accepted and reflected back toward the source with double their original intensity, utilizing the lack of self-assertion as a catalyst for a perfect and effortless counter that requires no movement.|

|THE Absolute Erasure of the Self: By surrendering your ego, you can phase through any barrier or binding that relies on identifying the target, for the bindings of the Gilded cannot find a person where no person exists, permitting you to navigate the most restricted layers of the Braneworld as if they were empty air.|

|As of now, the Egos of Superbius and Humilitas are the only ones available for your immediate transformation, with their abilities capable of expansion and addition as more infinity is infused into them, and the remaining twelve are still being designed and infused with the necessary concentrations of Infinity to achieve their Absolute states within the forge.|

Noah read the prompts as his eyes blazed with a dark and calculating brilliance, for he could already see how these two states would allow him to navigate the dangerous waters of the Braneworld with a versatility that no other Gilded One could match.
He looked at the two available transformations and could not help but nod his head as a sharp smile crossed his features, his mind already busy selecting which face he would show!
"Good. Good! Good!!"
HUUM!

As Noah was looking at the nondescript form of Humilitas, a piercing scream echoed out to ruin the calmness of this space as like a meteor, a manic existence thundered down into the forge where her Heart was!
"AAAH!"
BOOM!

The impact sent ripples of multicolored light across the crystalline floors of this grand workshop, and the air itself groaned under the sudden weight of a presence that was as chaotic as it was undeniably powerful.
Noah sighed lightly while the remnants of the impact settled around the intruder, and he whispered to himself as if he were reciting a mantra intended to preserve his patience.
"She gave her Everything for you," he murmured, his voice barely a breath against the humming of the Absolute Forge. "She gave her Everything...she gave her Everything..."
After repeating this three times and ensuring that his pragmatic temper was sufficiently anchored, he turned to see her.

The figure that rose from the center of the impact was THE Living Emotive, but she was no longer the skittish being who had crumbled at the base of the mountain, for her infusion with his Quintessence Infiniforce had triggered a transformation that made her power burn with a shocking brilliance!

She now stood firmly within THE Transitional Cambrian stage between THE Second Scale and THE Third Scale, her aura radiating a density of authority that would have made even a high-tier Primordial Architect tremble in her presence.

She looked around with the skittish and frenetic intensity of a rabbit caught in a high-tier snare before her focus finally sharpened onto the figure of Noah, her eyes lighting up with a manic brilliance that caused her body to instinctively surge forward.

She appeared as if she wanted to climb toward him and anchor herself to his existence as she had done on the mountain, yet she managed to hold herself back by gripping her own shoulders while her manic violet hair cycled through a strobe light of emotional colors.

She breathed in and out with a visible effort to control her own manic impulses before she finally rose up grandly, her gaze sweeping across the vast and immaculate expanse of the forge while her eyes eventually settled on her own pulsing Absolute Amaranthine Heart at the center of the room.

Her eyes began to sparkle with a renewed and terrifying fanaticism as she took in the fourteen massive illusory Egos of Infinity that surrounded her heart, and she voiced her question with a voice that was thick with wonder.
"Sir, where are we?"
Noah looked at her for a moment while noting that her eyes were shining far too brilliantly for his comfort, and he simply offered another heavy sigh before waving his hand toward her.

A single, concentrated drop of multicolored Infinity surged from his finger and entered her body, carrying with it the partial weight of the information regarding this place and the architecture of his internal reality, for she had her heart in this place and deserved to understand the significance of where she stood!

chapters.title: Chapter 5178: Ego IV
paragraphs: Her eyes lit up as she processed the boundless waves of data in an instant, and beside Noah, the illusory figure of Ruination could be seen with a disgruntled expression that suggested she was not a fan of the specific prompts she was currently being required to generate.
Ruination floated around the space while the data settled into Emotive’s mind, and she uttered the prompts with a cadence that carried a hint of annoyance.
|Due to the unique circumstances of the developmental transition, the subject, THE Living Emotive, has achieved an unprecedented synergy with THE Absolute Forge of Infinity.|

|Since the intensity of her emotions and the essence of her heart were utilized as the primary stabilizing anchor during the amplification of the engineered Egos to counteract the Absolute Infinity pouring into them, she has become an intrinsic part of the resulting architecture.|
|As a consequence of this existential overlap, Emotive possesses the capability to take on the forms of THE Absolute Egos of Infinity at fifty percent effectiveness compared to the primary wielder.|

Noah listened to these prompts with a calm and measured composure while he looked at Emotive again, observing her as she stood upright and stared back at him with an expression that was far too bright for its own good.

He could see that she was holding back boundless emotions within her foundations, her very existence vibrating with the pride of being allowed to share in the tools of her Fixation, and he could not help but reflect on the sheer absurdity of the situation.
Truly, she was far too lucky!

The woman had practically stumbled into a tier of power that most beings would have spent eons pursuing and not achieved, and she had done so by simply following her own manic obsessions to their ultimate and sacrificial conclusion!
Noah looked at the fourteen Egos and then back at the woman whose heart served as part of their engine as he shook his head and got ready to work.
He looked over at Emotive and beckoned.
"You, come here."
"Yes Sir!"
She rushed over like a dog let loose as internally, Noah had a lot more intricacies and engineering to uncover.
In THE Infiniverse.

The Realm of Dreams stretched outward in an endless expanse of shifting golden sands that glittered beneath the multicolored storms of the Thermal Infinimum, the atmosphere of this domain now thick with a heavy and nutrient-rich humidity that caused massive structures of dreaming glass to sprout from the dunes like translucent towers of frozen light.

Within the heart of this frantic and accelerated development, the Nearu Absolute Clone of Noah stood with a quiet and terrifying composure, his figure radiating a soft multicolored brilliance that served as a stable anchor against the chaotic growth of the surrounding territory.
Beside him, Naldine and Midas could be seen!
Noah looked at them for a long and patient moment before he moved.
"THE Absolute Superbius Ego of Infinity."

With a slow and measured movement of his hands, he reached into the depths of his Absolute Forge of Infinity and called upon the first of his completed iterations, the air around him groaning as the Nearu Absolute Infinity within his organ began to resonate with the manic resonance of the Amaranthine Heart.
HUUM!

The transformation was not a gradual shift but a total and violent overwriting of his current manifestation, for his skin suddenly became more opaque and radiant while shimmering with the luster of polished obsidian and molten gold!

A set of regal robes manifested around his frame, the fabric appearing to be composed of liquid shadow and burning starlight that flowed with its own independent rhythm, and his posture straightened into a configuration of such undeniable majesty that the dreaming glass forests nearby seemed to lean away in a gesture of involuntary submission!

His eyes, though no longer glazed with the clinical void, blazed with a pride so absolute that it seemed to dictate the terms of existence for everything within his reach, and the very cadence of his breath became a rhythmic assertion of his singular supremacy.

He adjusted the flow of his presence, acclimating to the staggering weight of THE Absolute Superbius Ego of Infinity, and every mannerism he displayed began to emanate a regal pride that made the previous Noah appear as a mere shadow of the monarch he had now become.
He looked at Naldine and Midas, and when he spoke, his voice carried the heavy and unhurried resonance of a king whose words were already written into the laws of reality.
"The bindings of the Sisterhood...of Sororis Prima Elzyana are merely that. Suggestions. As of now, I reject these flimsy suggestions."
BOOM!

Noah raised his hand toward the two Nascent Hadeans, and he proceeded to utilize THE Sovereign Overwrite to address the pyramidal constructs that still pulsed with a faint blue-gold brilliance upon their skin!

This terrifying capability did not manifest as a simple destructive force, but as a tidal wave of multicolored authority that treated the Gilded bindings as mere errors in a document that required immediate correction!
BOOM!

As his authority made contact with the bindings, the air around Naldine and Midas began to crackle with the sound of breaking glass, the blue-gold light of Elzyana’s wrath struggling to maintain its geometry against the overwhelming weight of Noah’s Pride.

The pyramidal constructs were fundamentally rewritten into the palette of the Absolute Forge, their golden-blue essence being unmade and rewoven into flickers of multicolored Infinity that were immediately absorbed back into the local environment!

The severance of the bindings was total and clinical, the Sororis authority being erased from their foundations as if it had never existed, for the Sovereign Overwrite permitted no disagreement and recognized no higher power than the one who had unleashed it!

Naldine felt the sudden and violent return of her own power, her singularity-dotted eyes widening as the forced dormancy of her Civilization was shattered by the intervention of Noah, and even the greed-personified Midas let out a low and resonant rumble of satisfaction as his golden rings began to orbit with a renewed and terrifying velocity!

The desolation that had hung over them since the afternoon was washed away by the radiation of Noah’s supremacy, leaving them standing within the golden sands as beings who were once again whole and unrestricted.

Noah lowered his hand while the last remnants of the rewritten bindings dissolved into the dreaming glass, his figure still radiating the suffocating pressure of his Superbius state as he looked out across the expanding horizons of his domain before he called out...
"THE Absolute Humilitas Ego of Infinity."
WU!

Noah breathed out and the majestic weight of the Superbius Ego began to dissolve, the molten gold of his robes and the suffocating pressure of his regal pride fading into a simple grey shroud that seemed to absorb the ambient light rather than reflect it, and his posture softened from that of a king into that of a being who had reached a state of total and absolute release!

His eyes, which had previously blazed with the fires of an unyielding sovereignty, now became deep and quiet pools of blue that held the stillness of an eternal void, and every mannerism he displayed transitioned into a glorious and terrifying lack of self-assertion that made him appear more like a natural feature of the dreamscape than a living entity.
HUUM!

The transformation into THE Absolute Humilitas Ego of Infinity was so profound that Naldine Manthon blinked while her singularity-dotted eyes struggled to maintain their focus on the space where Noah stood, for while his physical form had not moved, the very concept of his presence had begun to unravel within her perception until she was looking at nothing but the shifting golden sands of the Realm of Dreams!

Beside her, the engineered greed of Midas rumbled in confusion as his rings of Greed slowed their rotation, his instinct to track and covet power finding no purchase on a being who had successfully discarded every layer of observable ego, and for a long moment, the two Nascent Hadeans stood alone as if Noah had never been there at all!

Noah allowed himself to remain in this state of perfect invisibility for a heartbeat longer before he intentionally projected a flicker of his authority to show himself once more, appearing as a soft and nondescript shadow against the glittering dunes.

"Another me will come soon as we prepare for some grand things,"he said, his voice now a quiet and resonant murmur that carried no trace of his former arrogance, "so for now, join the others in The Early Veiled Shore and wait."
Naldine and Midas gave a synchronized nod of understanding as the Humilitas manifestation of Noah dissipated into the golden air without leaving a single trace of his passage!

He quickly appeared and moved across the vast expanse of the Wastes with a terrifying speed, his figure a mere ghost weaving through the glimmering multicolored rain and the torrential storms of the Pluvial Epoch that continued to drench the transformed landscape in the essence of his developmental phenomenon.

He eventually reached the outskirts of The Wandering Territories, a region filled with inverted landmasses and floating valleys of multicolored brilliance where the laws of spatial orientation appeared to have been discarded.

It was a place of impossible geometries and shifting horizons, and it was here, within a valley where the light flowed upward like a reverse waterfall, that he settled into a patient wait for the Sororis from THE Magna Sorora who would serve as the bridge to his next grand objective.

THE Genesis Monarch sat upon a crystalline ledge while looking out toward, his presence so thoroughly erased by his Ego that even the ambient Infinity of the region seemed to flow through him without resistance, and he waited for the hour of his crossing to begin!

Naldine felt the sudden and violent return of her own power, her singularity-dotted eyes widening as the forced dormancy of her Civilization was shattered by the intervention of Noah, and even the greed-personified Midas let out a low and resonant rumble of satisfaction as his golden rings began to orbit with a renewed and terrifying velocity!

The desolation that had hung over them since the afternoon was washed away by the radiation of Noah’s supremacy, leaving them standing within the golden sands as beings who were once again whole and unrestricted.

Noah lowered his hand while the last remnants of the rewritten bindings dissolved into the dreaming glass, his figure still radiating the suffocating pressure of his Superbius state as he looked out across the expanding horizons of his domain before he called out...
"THE Absolute Humilitas Ego of Infinity."
WU!

Noah breathed out and the majestic weight of the Superbius Ego began to dissolve, the molten gold of his robes and the suffocating pressure of his regal pride fading into a simple grey shroud that seemed to absorb the ambient light rather than reflect it, and his posture softened from that of a king into that of a being who had reached a state of total and absolute release!

His eyes, which had previously blazed with the fires of an unyielding sovereignty, now became deep and quiet pools of blue that held the stillness of an eternal void, and every mannerism he displayed transitioned into a glorious and terrifying lack of self-assertion that made him appear more like a natural feature of the dreamscape than a living entity.
HUUM!

The transformation into THE Absolute Humilitas Ego of Infinity was so profound that Naldine Manthon blinked while her singularity-dotted eyes struggled to maintain their focus on the space where Noah stood, for while his physical form had not moved, the very concept of his presence had begun to unravel within her perception until she was looking at nothing but the shifting golden sands of the Realm of Dreams!

Beside her, the engineered greed of Midas rumbled in confusion as his rings of Greed slowed their rotation, his instinct to track and covet power finding no purchase on a being who had successfully discarded every layer of observable ego, and for a long moment, the two Nascent Hadeans stood alone as if Noah had never been there at all!

Noah allowed himself to remain in this state of perfect invisibility for a heartbeat longer before he intentionally projected a flicker of his authority to show himself once more, appearing as a soft and nondescript shadow against the glittering dunes.

"Another me will come soon as we prepare for some grand things,"he said, his voice now a quiet and resonant murmur that carried no trace of his former arrogance, "so for now, join the others in The Early Veiled Shore and wait."
Naldine and Midas gave a synchronized nod of understanding as the Humilitas manifestation of Noah dissipated into the golden air without leaving a single trace of his passage!

He quickly appeared and moved across the vast expanse of the Wastes with a terrifying speed, his figure a mere ghost weaving through the glimmering multicolored rain and the torrential storms of the Pluvial Epoch that continued to drench the transformed landscape in the essence of his developmental phenomenon.

He eventually reached the outskirts of The Wandering Territories, a region filled with inverted landmasses and floating valleys of multicolored brilliance where the laws of spatial orientation appeared to have been discarded.

It was a place of impossible geometries and shifting horizons, and it was here, within a valley where the light flowed upward like a reverse waterfall, that he settled into a patient wait for the Sororis from THE Magna Sorora who would serve as the bridge to his next grand objective.

THE Genesis Monarch sat upon a crystalline ledge while looking out toward, his presence so thoroughly erased by his Ego that even the ambient Infinity of the region seemed to flow through him without resistance, and he waited for the hour of his crossing to begin!

chapters.title: Chapter 5179: What Makes You Tick?
paragraphs: Existence was vast and filled with dangers, housing entities who had been alive for billions of years and eons, each of them having developed their own means of power and their own civilizations while existence itself remained filled with many anomalies that had matured through time, adversity, and innovation.

There were monsters out there who could likely pinch their fingers and cause an entire Observable Existence to go dark, for the scales of power were not merely linear but were layered with the weight of ancient engineering and the terrifying reach of beings who had moved beyond the concepts of mortality!

This reality was the sandbox upon which these titans painted their wills, and to those who had not yet reached such heights, the sheer scope of the potential threats was enough to paralyze the spirit, yet for those who sought the summit, it was the ultimate motivation to never allow the fires of their own progress to dim.

Noah knew how dangerous Observable Existence could be, and he had gotten a vivid glimpse of that danger with the single member of THE Magna Sorora who had descended upon the ruins of THE Gilded White Mountain.

He had been able to do nothing against her while she stood in the sky, and he could only observe defiantly as she laid the clinical bindings that permeated across all of Observable Existence with a casual efficiency that spoke of an unfathomable depth of authority.

Even figures of great depth like Erwin and THE Creature had been required to do a great deal of preparation and design to affect the entire Observable, and yet for THE Gilded Ones, such monumental feats appeared to be simple, routine procedures that required no more effort than a gardener might spend pruning a single branch.

It was precisely because he understood that existence was dangerous that he never allowed himself to feel a true sense of ease or to become laid back as if everything would somehow be okay, for Sororis Prima Elzyana was only a single being, a single Gilded One out of a countless number who had been alive for eons within THE Braneworld.

Even with the terrifying capabilities that he had just begun to unlock through his Nearu Absolute Infinity, Noah only saw them as potential points of opportunity that he could utilize to advance as he began to walk among monsters who had existentially engineered themselves.
He knew that to survive and eventually thrive in the face of such beings, he would have to begin with a fundamental understanding of exactly what THE Gilded Ones were at their very basal components.
He stood within THE Realm of Genesis inside THE Infiniverse, the air of the domain vibrating with the concentrated essence of his glorious Infiniverse.
"Are you all ready?"
His voice was calm and steady as he looked at the figures gathered around him, for he was surrounded by those who had served as his primary architects of development.

Naldine Manthon stood with her radiant white hair glowing, and beside her was the Arch Lich Ra’Zan whose deathly Hadean bones shone with a deep and ancient light that suggested a mastery over the transition between life and unlife.
Dr. Hall remained in his pristine white lab coat with his golden hair shining lustrously, his eyes reflecting the sharp, analytical focus of a man who lived for the moment of discovery.

They were all surrounding a massive, clean white table made from the condensed weavings of Genesis, and upon that pristine surface lay the beating heart of a Gilded One, a collection of vessels that formed a humanoid shape, and other vibrant golden points of light that pulsed with a rhythm that defied the ordinary laws of biology.
These were the remnants carved out by THE Creature, a gift of raw Gilded architecture that carried a terrifying allure of power just from being unveiled to the atmosphere of the realm!

Dr. Hall and Arch Lich Ra’Zan had come only after the direct bidding of their Master, and they listened to his instructions with silent intensity, but Naldine was still fresh to the sight of such things and she could not help but shake her head in disbelief.
"This cannot really be the inner components of a Gilded One, right?" she asked, her eyes filled with a heavy suspicion as she looked between the pulsing heart and Noah.
"How could you possibly get your hands on such a thing, and... just what else are you hiding from me?"
Noah stepped closer to the table, the multicolored light of his eyes reflecting off the vibrant golden remnants of the dead Gerousia.
"Existence finds a way,"he said, his voice carrying the dark amusement.
"Come on. If we can reverse engineer and break down exactly what makes a Gilded One tick, then we can do many, many things from there to ensure our own standing remains unchallenged."

Yes, many things could be possible, and even Noah himself could utilize this gift from THE Creature in a myriad of different ways, although he did not even think of transplanting these organs or this system into his own existence.

He did not want such a dredge of filth to be inside him, for he found the engineered arrogance of THE Gilded to be a stain on the purity of his own path, and he would continue forging his own organs and his own wonders as he built his Infinite Scale from the ground up.

He acknowledged that there were many scary monsters out there and likely many beings who were currently much stronger than he was, and while they had the advantage of time, he had Infinity and his own boundless, tyrannical Quintessence to bridge the gap.
"Let’s get to work!"

He delved into the procedure with a sharp excitement that permeated the air, and those around him followed his lead as the Manifestations of Ruination and THE Infiniverse watched from the heights of the domain. They analyzed every movement and every reaction as the procedure commenced, their collective focus directed toward the singular question that would define their next phase of development.
What the hell made a Gilded One tick?
HUUM!
